How we proved it never halts

Walls that never collide, and a counter on a fixed schedule

Each time the head walks in from the left edge and back, it delivers one carry into a long row of short blocks, like the input wheel of an odometer. Digit blocks count in binary (0000 is a 0, 1000 a 1), and wire blocks 11000 pass carries straight through. Walls (111000 or 011000) swallow every second carry; on the others a wall sends three carries onward and creeps one block to the right.

A small gadget at the left end repeats exactly, adding 8 new walls every 8 times the head reaches fresh tape there. The walls ride the wire in single file and are swallowed one by one by a binary counter at the far right. The machine can halt only after a hit: a creeping wall pushing into a block that is not wire or a plain digit, such as another wall.

The key idea: on the wire a hit is impossible, since three carries always turn the block ahead of a creeping wall into wire. At the far counter, a bookkeeping identity shows that the carries arriving between two swallowed walls depend only on the wall's place in the cycle of 8 and on how far the counter's edge has moved. So the counter runs on a fixed schedule, which the proof shows never produces a hit.

Why that settles it: at each visit to a fresh cell on the left, two counts (visits so far, walls swallowed) fix the whole tape, and that description carries over to the next visit with no hit on the way. The first such visit comes at step 203,465, so the machine never halts.

The Rocq proof checks each block's rule by running the machine on that block alone, the rest of the tape a black box. Computation covers the gadget, the opening and thousands of representative counter runs; the visit-to-visit step is proved for all 8 kinds of visit.

Overview

In one sentence

Period-5 tape; 5-state walls drift right x1.5 per level (3/2 conveyor); right-edge counter absorbs them; no halt branch.

Submitted mechanism Carries. Read the tape as a word of units D0 = 0000, D1 = 1000, P = 11000, S1 = 01000, SP = 011000, W = 111000. Each walk of B to the right and C back from the left edge is one carry, and it acts on the unit word as a recursive increment (Theorem U). (submission/README.md, Mechanism)

Mechanism

What to check here: the pictures show the mechanism that the rule table describes.

How it works: 3 notes
  • Tape = period-5 pattern: B sweeping right turns 11000 into 10111; C sweeping left turns it back (5 steps/block).
  • Walls are 5-state gadgets: B bounces once then passes, C twice then passes; each round moves a wall 5 cells right.
  • So each wall is crossed 3/2 as often as the one to its left; walls are born at the left, absorbed at the right.

Structural counter + counter, Counter Class 4 · ready to paste · source
Is anyone working on any of these Structural counter + counter / Counter Class 4 holdouts, or has anyone tried them and got stuck? We found no sheet notes, threads or claims, and none are on mxdys's UBRRBA list or dyuan01's longitudinal list.

1. `1RB0LC_1LA0RE_0RD1LF_1LC1LB_0LD0RB_0LA---`, `1RB0LC_1LA0RE_0RD0LA_1RE1RA_0LD1RF_0RB---`, `1RB1RC_0LA1RF_1RD0LE_1LC0RB_0RA0LC_0RD---` (identical trajectories to 1e9). Period-5 background `10110` carrying a binary counter whose digits are 3-cell defects (`110` = 1, `100` = 0). Digits drift left on carries, and a bit counter at the left edge absorbs them.
2. `1RB---_1LC1RE_1LD0LC_1LE1LC_1RF0RE_1RA0RB`. Period-5 tape cut into segments by phase-shift walls. Each wall moves 3/2 times as often as the one to its left, so segment lengths run 12, 18, 27, 41, 61, 92, 138, 206 blocks.
3. `1RB1LC_1RC1LB_1LD0RB_0LE1RD_---0LF_0LA1LF` and its twin `1RB1LA_1LC0RA_0LD1RC_---0LE_0LF1LE_1RF1LB`. Run-length counter whose epochs double in length. Each epoch starts at `0^inf <A 0 1^3 0^2 1^2 0^2 1^(2k) 0^2 1^(2k+1) 0^P 1 0^Q 1 0^inf` with P+Q = 2k and P irregular. No halt in 1e11 steps; in a macro simulation every even P closes the epoch for k <= 13.

What we checked: direct simulation (1e9 steps for groups 1 and 2, 1e11 for group 3), plus the local rules above on random instances. No proofs yet. If nobody has them, we'll write Rocq proofs, starting with group 1.

Proof strategy & riskshow the formal proof will go · 3 risks to watch

Prove sweeps with ind and the 5 wall rules with es. Encode the tape as a list of (segment length, wall state) with an Inductive trip relation (CounterCmp_v1 P, BECv7 digit encoding); prove one head trip by induction on the list, then a closed invariant (left gadget + list + right barrier) and finish with progress_nonhalt_cond / multistep_nonhalt.

  • ▲Right barrier (0001 zone) is a second counter: last-segment growth per cycle is 4-12 blocks depending on a; needs its own case analysis.
  • ▲Exact wall spacings follow a 3/2 rounding orbit; the invariant must bound them, not pin them (200/200 perturbed tapes ran 1e8 steps without halting).
  • ▲No proof in this class yet; nested trip induction may give a 30-60 KB file.

486Definition dval (u : unt) : nat := match u with uD1 => 1 | _ => 0 end.
487Definition isdig (u : unt) : bool := match u with uD0 | uD1 => true | _ => false end.
489Lemma IncN_digit t u w w' : isdig u = true -> IncN ((dval u + t) / 2) w w' ->
490 IncN t (u :: w) (dig (dval u + t) :: w').

495 - destruct u; try discriminate; cbn in *.

502 2:{ cbn [dval]. rewrite !Nat.add_0_l. replace (S (S t)) with (t + 1 * 2)%nat by lia.
503 rewrite Nat.div_add by lia. lia. }

507 eapply IncN_add.

509 * replace (dig (dval uD0 + (2 + t))) with (dig (dval uD0 + t)).

528(* walls: SP (state 0, absorbs the next carry) and W (state 1, fires) *)
529Definition wallu (b : bool) : unt := if b then uW else uSP.
531Lemma Inc_SP_W r : Inc (uSP :: r) (uW :: r).
532Proof. constructor. Qed.
534(* a firing: three carries on the rest, then the shift lands on its first unit, a P *)
535Lemma Inc_W_fire r r' : Inc3Pop r r' -> Inc (uW :: r) (uP :: uSP :: r').
536Proof.
537 intros [a [b [H1 [H2 H3]]]]. eapply Inc_W; eauto.
538Qed.
540Lemma Pops_add a b U U1 U2 : Pops a U U1 -> Pops b U1 U2 -> Pops (a + b) U U2.
541Proof.

543 - subst; auto.
544 - destruct H1 as [V [HV H1]]. exists V. split; [auto|eapply IH; eauto].
545Qed.
547Lemma Pops_split a b U U2 : Pops (a + b) U U2 -> exists U1, Pops a U U1 /\ Pops b U1 U2.
548Proof.

550 - exists U. split; auto.
551 - destruct H as [V [HV H]]. destruct (IH _ H) as [U1 [H1 H2]].
552 exists U1. split; auto. exists V. auto.
553Qed.
555(* the rotor: t carries on a wall in state b fire it (t + b) / 2 times *)
556Lemma wall_feed t (b : bool) r r' :
557 Pops ((t + Nat.b2n b) / 2) r r' ->
558 IncN t (wallu b :: r) (Ps ((t + Nat.b2n b) / 2) ++ wallu (Nat.odd (t + Nat.b2n b)) :: r').
559Proof.

561 destruct b.
562 - (* W *)
563 destruct t as [|t].
564 + cbn in *. subst. constructor.
565 + replace ((S t + Nat.b2n true) / 2) with (1 + (t + Nat.b2n false) / 2) in *.
566 2:{ cbn [Nat.b2n]. replace (S t + 1) with (t + 0 + 1 * 2) by lia.
567 rewrite Nat.div_add by lia. lia. }
568 destruct (Pops_split _ _ _ _ H) as [r1 [H1 H2]].
569 cbn in H1. destruct H1 as [V [HV E]]. subst V.
570 econstructor.
571 * apply Inc_W_fire. eauto.
572 * assert (E : forall x y, Ps (1 + x) ++ y = uP :: (Ps x ++ y)) by reflexivity.
573 rewrite E. apply IncN_P.
574 replace (Nat.odd (S t + Nat.b2n true)) with (Nat.odd (t + Nat.b2n false)).
575 { exact (IH t ltac:(lia) false r1 r' H2). }
576 cbn [Nat.b2n]. replace (S t + 1) with (S (S (t + 0))) by lia.
577 rewrite Nat.odd_succ_succ. reflexivity.
578 - (* SP *)
579 destruct t as [|t].
580 + cbn in *. subst. constructor.
581 + replace ((S t + Nat.b2n false) / 2) with ((t + Nat.b2n true) / 2) in *.
582 2:{ cbn [Nat.b2n]. f_equal. lia. }
583 econstructor.
584 * apply Inc_SP_W.
585 * replace (Nat.odd (S t + Nat.b2n false)) with (Nat.odd (t + Nat.b2n true)).
586 { apply (IH t ltac:(lia) true). auto. }
587 cbn [Nat.b2n]. f_equal. lia.
588Qed.
590(* Lemma C1: three carries turn a first unit P, S1, SP or W into P *)
591Lemma C1 u r x : In u [uP; uS1; uSP; uW] -> IncN 3 (u :: r) x -> exists x', x = uP :: x'.
592Proof.
593 intros Hu H.
594 destruct Hu as [<-|[<-|[<-|[<-|[]]]]].
595 - apply IncN_P_inv in H. destruct H as [w' [E _]]. eauto.
596 - inversion H as [|n w w1 w2 Hi Hn]; subst. inversion Hi; subst.
597 apply IncN_P_inv in Hn. destruct Hn as [w' [E _]]. eauto.
598 - inversion H as [|n w w1 w2 Hi Hn]; subst. inversion Hi; subst.
599 inversion Hn as [|n' w' wa wb Hi' Hn']; subst. inversion Hi'; subst.
600 apply IncN_P_inv in Hn'. destruct Hn' as [w'' [E _]]. eauto.
601 - inversion H as [|n w w1 w2 Hi Hn]; subst. inversion Hi; subst.
602 apply IncN_P_inv in Hn. destruct Hn as [w' [E _]]. eauto.
603Qed.
605(* r binary digits of v, least significant first *)
606Fixpoint digits (r v : nat) : list unt :=
607 match r with
608 | O => []
609 | S r' => dig v :: digits r' (v / 2)
610 end.
612Lemma dval_dig v : dval (dig v) = v mod 2.
613Proof.
614 unfold dig. destruct (Nat.eqb_spec (v mod 2) 0) as [E|E]; cbn [dval]; [lia|].
615 pose proof (Nat.mod_upper_bound v 2). lia.
616Qed.
618Lemma isdig_dig v : isdig (dig v) = true.
619Proof. unfold dig. destruct (Nat.eqb (v mod 2) 0); reflexivity. Qed.
621Lemma dig_mod v : dig (v mod 2) = dig v.
622Proof. unfold dig. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_mod. reflexivity. Qed.
624(* t carries on an r-digit counter pass ((v mod 2^r) + t) / 2^r carries up *)
625Lemma IncN_digits r v t rest rest' :
626 IncN ((v mod 2 ^ r + t) / 2 ^ r) rest rest' ->
627 IncN t (digits r v ++ rest) (digits r (v + t) ++ rest').
628Proof.
629 revert v t. induction r as [|r IH]; intros v t H.
630 - cbn [digits app]. replace ((v mod 2 ^ 0 + t) / 2 ^ 0) with t in H; [auto|].
631 rewrite Nat.pow_0_r, Nat.mod_1_r, Nat.div_1_r. lia.
632 - cbn [digits app].
633 assert (Ev : v = 2 * (v / 2) + v mod 2) by (apply Nat.div_mod; lia).
634 assert (E1 : (v + t) / 2 = v / 2 + (v mod 2 + t) / 2).
635 { rewrite Ev at 1. replace (2 * (v / 2) + v mod 2 + t) with ((v mod 2 + t) + (v / 2) * 2) by lia.
636 rewrite Nat.div_add by lia. lia. }
637 replace (dig (v + t)) with (dig (dval (dig v) + t)).
638 2:{ rewrite dval_dig. rewrite <- dig_mod, <- (dig_mod (v + t)). f_equal.
639 rewrite Nat.Div0.add_mod_idemp_l. reflexivity. }
640 apply IncN_digit; [apply isdig_dig|].
641 rewrite E1, dval_dig. apply IH.
642 replace ((v / 2) mod 2 ^ r + (v mod 2 + t) / 2) with ((v mod 2 ^ S r + t) / 2).
643 + rewrite Nat.Div0.div_div. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. exact H.
644 + rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_mul_r.
645 replace (v mod 2 + 2 * ((v / 2) mod 2 ^ r) + t) with ((v mod 2 + t) + ((v / 2) mod 2 ^ r) * 2) by lia.
646 rewrite Nat.div_add by lia. lia.
647Qed.

650(* 8. The closed zone system (proof.md section 5). *)
651(* ===================================================================== *)
653Definition notP (w : list unt) : Prop := match w with uP :: _ => False | _ => True end.
655Definition pj (j : nat) : nat := nth (j mod 8) [47; 48; 48; 47; 48; 47; 48; 47] 47.
657(* one step: feed c = D + p(j) carries, every leading P is dropped and adds
658 3 carries, stop at the least fixed point m = c + 3 A(m), then the
659 absorption shift *)
660Definition cs_step (Z : list unt) (D j : nat) (Z' : list unt) (D' j' : nat) : Prop :=
661 exists m A Y,
662 IncN m Z (Ps A ++ Y) /\ notP Y /\ m = D + pj j + 3 * A /\
663 (forall m' A' Y', m' < m -> IncN m' Z (Ps A' ++ Y') -> notP Y' -> m' <> D + pj j + 3 * A') /\
664 shift Y = Some Z' /\ D' = D + A /\ j' = S j.
666Inductive CSreach : list unt -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
667| CS1 : CSreach [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD0; uD1] 0 1
668| CSS Z D j Z' D' j' : CSreach Z D j -> cs_step Z D j Z' D' j' -> CSreach Z' D' j'.
670(* executable carries *)
671Fixpoint incf (n : nat) (w : list unt) : option (list unt) :=
672 match n with
673 | O => None
674 | S n' =>
675 match w with
676 | [] => Some [uD1]
677 | uD0 :: w' => Some (uD1 :: w')
678 | uS1 :: w' => Some (uP :: w')
679 | uSP :: w' => Some (uW :: w')
680 | uD1 :: w' => match incf n' w' with Some x => Some (uD0 :: x) | None => None end
681 | uP :: w' => match incf n' w' with Some x => Some (uP :: x) | None => None end
682 | uW :: w' =>
683 match incf n' w' with
684 | None => None
685 | Some x1 =>
686 match incf n' x1 with
687 | None => None
688 | Some x2 =>
689 match incf n' x2 with
690 | None => None
691 | Some x3 => match shift x3 with Some x4 => Some (uP :: x4) | None => None end
692 end
693 end
694 end
695 end
696 end.
698Lemma incf_sound n w w' : incf n w = Some w' -> Inc w w'.
699Proof.
700 revert w w'; induction n as [|n IH]; intros w w' H; [discriminate|].
701 destruct w as [|u w]; cbn in H.
702 - inversion H; constructor.
703 - destruct u.
704 + inversion H; constructor.
705 + destruct (incf n w) eqn:E; inversion H; subst. constructor; auto.
706 + destruct (incf n w) eqn:E; inversion H; subst. constructor; auto.
707 + inversion H; constructor.
708 + inversion H; constructor.
709 + destruct (incf n w) as [x1|] eqn:E1; [|discriminate].
710 destruct (incf n x1) as [x2|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate].
711 destruct (incf n x2) as [x3|] eqn:E3; [|discriminate].
712 destruct (shift x3) as [x4|] eqn:E4; inversion H; subst.
713 eapply Inc_W; eauto.
714Qed.
716Fixpoint incNf (fuel k : nat) (w : list unt) : option (list unt) :=
717 match k with
718 | O => Some w
719 | S k' => match incf fuel w with Some x => incNf fuel k' x | None => None end
720 end.
722Lemma incNf_sound fuel k w w' : incNf fuel k w = Some w' -> IncN k w w'.
723Proof.
724 revert w; induction k as [|k IH]; intros w H; cbn in H.
725 - inversion H; constructor.
726 - destruct (incf fuel w) eqn:E; [|discriminate].
727 econstructor; [eapply incf_sound; eauto|]. auto.
728Qed.
730Fixpoint splitP (w : list unt) : nat * list unt :=
731 match w with
732 | uP :: w' => let (a, y) := splitP w' in (S a, y)
733 | _ => (O, w)
734 end.
736Lemma splitP_spec w : let (a, y) := splitP w in w = Ps a ++ y /\ notP y.
737Proof.
738 induction w as [|u w IH]; cbn; [split; [reflexivity|exact I]|].
739 destruct u; try (split; [reflexivity|exact I]).
740 destruct (splitP w) as [a y]. destruct IH as [E N]. subst. split; auto.
741Qed.
743Lemma Ps_notP_inj a b x y : Ps a ++ x = Ps b ++ y -> notP x -> notP y -> a = b /\ x = y.
744Proof.
745 revert b; induction a as [|a IH]; intros [|b] E Nx Ny; cbn in *.
746 - auto.
747 - subst. contradiction.
748 - subst. contradiction.
749 - inversion E. destruct (IH b H0 Nx Ny). auto.
750Qed.
752(* leading P units are never lost *)
753Lemma IncN_Ps_inv k a y x : IncN k (Ps a ++ y) x -> exists y', x = Ps a ++ y' /\ IncN k y y'.
754Proof.
755 revert x; induction a as [|a IH]; intros x H; cbn in *.
756 - eauto.
757 - apply IncN_P_inv in H. destruct H as [w' [E H]]. subst.
758 destruct (IH _ H) as [y' [E2 H2]]. subst. eauto.
759Qed.
761Lemma Ps_prefix_le a b y Y : Ps a ++ y = Ps b ++ Y -> notP Y -> a <= b.
762Proof.
763 revert b; induction a as [|a IH]; intros [|b] E N; cbn in *; try lia.
764 - subst. contradiction.
765 - inversion E. specialize (IH b H0 N). lia.
766Qed.
768(* no fixed point at m' *)
769Definition NF (Z : list unt) (c m' : nat) : Prop :=
770 forall A' Y', IncN m' Z (Ps A' ++ Y') -> notP Y' -> m' <> c + 3 * A'.
772Fixpoint cs_loop (fuel cf c m : nat) (Zm : list unt) : option (nat * nat * list unt) :=
773 match fuel with
774 | O => None
775 | S f =>
776 let (a, y) := splitP Zm in
777 if Nat.eqb m (c + 3 * a) then Some (m, a, y)
778 else
779 match incNf cf (c + 3 * a - m) Zm with
780 | Some Zm' => cs_loop f cf c (c + 3 * a) Zm'
781 | None => None
782 end
783 end.
785Lemma cs_loop_sound fuel cf c Z m Zm m2 A2 Y2 :
786 cs_loop fuel cf c m Zm = Some (m2, A2, Y2) ->
787 IncN m Z Zm -> (forall m', m' < m -> NF Z c m') ->
788 (forall A Y, Zm = Ps A ++ Y -> notP Y -> m <= c + 3 * A) ->
789 IncN m2 Z (Ps A2 ++ Y2) /\ notP Y2 /\ m2 = c + 3 * A2 /\ (forall m', m' < m2 -> NF Z c m').
790Proof.
791 revert m Zm; induction fuel as [|f IH]; intros m Zm H HZ HNF Hle; [discriminate|].
792 cbn [cs_loop] in H. pose proof (splitP_spec Zm) as HS.
793 destruct (splitP Zm) as [A Y]. destruct HS as [EZ NY].
794 specialize (Hle A Y EZ NY).
795 destruct (Nat.eqb m (c + 3 * A)) eqn:Em; [apply Nat.eqb_eq in Em | apply Nat.eqb_neq in Em].
796 - inversion H; subst. repeat split; auto.
797 - destruct (incNf cf (c + 3 * A - m) Zm) as [Zm'|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
798 apply incNf_sound in E.
799 assert (HZ' : IncN (c + 3 * A) Z Zm').
800 { replace (c + 3 * A) with (m + (c + 3 * A - m)) by lia. eapply IncN_add; eauto. }
801 eapply IH; eauto.
802 + intros m' Hm' A' Y' H' NY'.
803 destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases m' m) as [Hlt|Hge].
804 * apply (HNF m' Hlt A' Y' H' NY').
805 * (* between m and c + 3A: at least A leading P *)
806 replace m' with (m + (m' - m)) in H' by lia.
807 destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ H') as [w1 [Hw1 Hw2]].
808 assert (w1 = Zm) by (eapply IncN_det; eauto). subst w1.
809 rewrite EZ in Hw2. destruct (IncN_Ps_inv _ _ _ _ Hw2) as [y' [Ey' _]].
810 pose proof (Ps_prefix_le _ _ _ _ (eq_sym Ey') NY'). lia.
811 + intros A' Y' EZ' NY'. subst Zm'.
812 replace (c + 3 * A) with (m + (c + 3 * A - m)) in HZ' by lia.
813 destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ HZ') as [w1 [Hw1 Hw2]].
814 assert (w1 = Zm) by (eapply IncN_det; eauto). subst w1.
815 rewrite EZ in Hw2. destruct (IncN_Ps_inv _ _ _ _ Hw2) as [y' [Ey' _]].
816 pose proof (Ps_prefix_le _ _ _ _ (eq_sym Ey') NY'). lia.
817Qed.
819Definition csf (fuel cf : nat) (s : list unt * nat * nat) : option (list unt * nat * nat) :=
820 let '(z, d, j) := s in
821 match incNf cf (d + pj j) z with
822 | None => None
823 | Some zc =>
824 match cs_loop fuel cf (d + pj j) (d + pj j) zc with
825 | None => None
826 | Some (m, a, y) =>
827 match shift y with
828 | Some z' => Some (z', d + a, S j)
829 | None => None
830 end
831 end
832 end.
834Lemma csf_sound fuel cf Z D j Z' D' j' :
835 csf fuel cf (Z, D, j) = Some (Z', D', j') -> cs_step Z D j Z' D' j'.
836Proof.
837 unfold csf. intros H.
838 destruct (incNf cf (D + pj j) Z) as [Zc|] eqn:E1; [|discriminate].
839 destruct (cs_loop fuel cf (D + pj j) (D + pj j) Zc) as [[[m A] Y]|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate].
840 destruct (shift Y) as [Z''|] eqn:E3; inversion H; subst.
841 apply incNf_sound in E1.
842 destruct (cs_loop_sound _ _ _ Z _ _ _ _ _ E2 E1) as [H1 [H2 [H3 H4]]].
843 - intros m' Hm' A' Y' _ _. lia.
844 - intros. lia.
845 - exists m, A, Y. repeat split; auto.
846 intros m' A' Y' Hm' HI HN. apply (H4 m' Hm' A' Y' HI HN).
847Qed.
849Fixpoint csiter (n : nat) (s : list unt * nat * nat) : option (list unt * nat * nat) :=
850 match n with
851 | O => Some s
852 | S n' => match csf 200 200 s with Some s' => csiter n' s' | None => None end
853 end.
855Lemma csiter_reach n Z D j Z' D' j' :
856 CSreach Z D j -> csiter n (Z, D, j) = Some (Z', D', j') -> CSreach Z' D' j'.
857Proof.
858 revert Z D j; induction n as [|n IH]; intros Z D j HR H; cbn [csiter] in H.
859 - inversion H; subst; auto.
860 - destruct (csf 200 200 (Z, D, j)) as [[[Z1 D1] j1]|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
861 eapply IH; [|exact H]. econstructor; [exact HR|]. eapply csf_sound; eauto.
862Qed.
864(* the closed system reaches the canonical state C(0) at j = 17 *)
865Lemma C0_reach : CSreach [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] 16 17.
866Proof.
867 eapply (csiter_reach 16); [constructor|].
868 vm_compute. reflexivity.
869Qed.

875Lemma IncN_3_inv w x : IncN 3 w x -> exists a b, Inc w a /\ Inc a b /\ Inc b x.
876Proof.
877 intros H.
878 inversion H as [|n1 w1 a1 x1 H1 Hn1]; subst.
879 inversion Hn1 as [|n2 w2 a2 x2 H2 Hn2]; subst.
880 inversion Hn2 as [|n3 w3 a3 x3 H3 Hn3]; subst.
881 inversion Hn3; subst. eauto.
882Qed.
884Lemma Inc3Pop_of w x : IncN 3 w (uP :: x) -> Inc3Pop w x.
885Proof. intros H. destruct (IncN_3_inv _ _ H) as [a [b [H1 [H2 H3]]]]. exists a, b. auto. Qed.
887Lemma IncN_of_Inc3Pop w x : Inc3Pop w x -> IncN 3 w (uP :: x).
888Proof.
889 intros [a [b [H1 [H2 H3]]]].
890 econstructor; [eauto|]. econstructor; [eauto|]. econstructor; [eauto|]. constructor.
891Qed.
893(* a firing over a wire: three carries pass the first P, which is popped *)
894Lemma Inc3Pop_P y y3 : IncN 3 y y3 -> Inc3Pop (uP :: y) y3.
895Proof. intros H. apply Inc3Pop_of. apply IncN_P. auto. Qed.
897Lemma Pops_Ps k a y y' : IncN (3 * k) y y' -> Pops k (Ps (k + a) ++ y) (Ps a ++ y').
898Proof.
899 revert y; induction k as [|k IH]; intros y H; cbn [Pops].
900 - cbn in *. inversion H; subst. reflexivity.
901 - replace (3 * S k) with (3 + 3 * k) in H by lia.
902 destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ H) as [y3 [H3 Hk]].
903 exists (Ps (k + a) ++ y3). split.
904 + cbn [Ps app]. apply Inc3Pop_P. apply IncN_Ps. auto.
905 + apply IH. auto.
906Qed.
908(* a firing directly below a wall: the wall above has moved (Lemma C1) *)
909Lemma Inc3Pop_wall (b : bool) r r' :
910 Pops ((3 + Nat.b2n b) / 2) r r' ->
911 Inc3Pop (wallu b :: r) (Ps ((3 + Nat.b2n b) / 2 - 1) ++ wallu (Nat.odd (3 + Nat.b2n b)) :: r').
912Proof.
913 intros H. apply Inc3Pop_of.
914 pose proof (wall_feed 3 b r r' H) as G.
915 destruct b; cbn in *; exact G.
916Qed.

920(* 10. Upward flow (Lemma L, item 1): a prefix X that passes e carries *)
921(* up, with every shift landing inside X, acts on X ++ Y as *)
922(* X' ++ inc^e(Y). *)
923(* ===================================================================== *)
925(* a shift that must land inside X *)
926Fixpoint shiftX (X : list unt) : option (list unt) :=
927 match X with
928 | [] => None
929 | uD0 :: X' =>
930 match shiftX X' with
931 | Some X'' => Some (uD0 :: X'')
932 | None => None
933 end
934 | uD1 :: X' => Some (uS1 :: X')
935 | uP :: X' => Some (uSP :: X')
936 | _ => None
937 end.
939Lemma shiftX_app X X' Y : shiftX X = Some X' -> shift (X ++ Y) = Some (X' ++ Y).
940Proof.
941 revert X'; induction X as [|u X IH]; intros X' H; cbn in H; [discriminate|].
942 destruct u; try discriminate.
943 - destruct (shiftX X) as [X''|] eqn:E; [|discriminate]. inversion H; subst.
944 cbn [app shift]. rewrite (IH X'' eq_refl). reflexivity.
945 - inversion H; subst. reflexivity.
946 - inversion H; subst. reflexivity.
947Qed.
949Inductive IncX : list unt -> nat -> list unt -> Prop :=
950| IncX_nil : IncX [] 1 []
951| IncX_D0 X : IncX (uD0 :: X) 0 (uD1 :: X)
952| IncX_S1 X : IncX (uS1 :: X) 0 (uP :: X)
953| IncX_SP X : IncX (uSP :: X) 0 (uW :: X)
954| IncX_D1 X e X' : IncX X e X' -> IncX (uD1 :: X) e (uD0 :: X')
955| IncX_P X e X' : IncX X e X' -> IncX (uP :: X) e (uP :: X')
956| IncX_W X e1 e2 e3 X1 X2 X3 X4 :
957 IncX X e1 X1 -> IncX X1 e2 X2 -> IncX X2 e3 X3 -> shiftX X3 = Some X4 ->
958 IncX (uW :: X) (e1 + e2 + e3) (uP :: X4).
960Lemma IncX_flow X e X' : IncX X e X' ->
961 forall Y Y', IncN e Y Y' -> Inc (X ++ Y) (X' ++ Y').
962Proof.
963 induction 1; intros Y Y' HY; cbn [app].
964 - apply IncN_1_inv. exact HY.
965 - inversion HY; subst. constructor.
966 - inversion HY; subst. constructor.
967 - inversion HY; subst. constructor.
968 - constructor. auto.
969 - constructor. auto.
970 - rewrite <- Nat.add_assoc in HY.
971 destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ HY) as [Y1 [Ha Hbc]].
972 destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ Hbc) as [Y2 [Hb Hc]].
973 eapply Inc_W.
974 + apply IHIncX1. exact Ha.
975 + apply IHIncX2. exact Hb.
976 + apply IHIncX3. exact Hc.
977 + apply shiftX_app. assumption.
978Qed.
980(* n carries on X *)
981Inductive IncXN : nat -> list unt -> nat -> list unt -> Prop :=
982| IncXN_0 X : IncXN 0 X 0 X
983| IncXN_S n X e X1 e' X2 : IncX X e X1 -> IncXN n X1 e' X2 -> IncXN (S n) X (e + e') X2.
985Lemma IncXN_flow n X e X' : IncXN n X e X' ->
986 forall Y Y', IncN e Y Y' -> IncN n (X ++ Y) (X' ++ Y').
987Proof.
988 induction 1; intros Y Y' HY.
989 - inversion HY; subst. constructor.
990 - destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ HY) as [Y1 [H1 H2]].
991 econstructor.
992 + eapply IncX_flow; eauto.
993 + apply IHIncXN. exact H2.
994Qed.
996(* executable version *)
997Fixpoint incXf (n : nat) (X : list unt) : option (nat * list unt) :=
998 match n with
999 | O => None
1000 | S n' =>
1001 match X with
1002 | [] => Some (1%nat, [])
1003 | uD0 :: X' => Some (O, uD1 :: X')
1004 | uS1 :: X' => Some (O, uP :: X')
1005 | uSP :: X' => Some (O, uW :: X')
1006 | uD1 :: X' => match incXf n' X' with Some (e, x) => Some (e, uD0 :: x) | None => None end
1007 | uP :: X' => match incXf n' X' with Some (e, x) => Some (e, uP :: x) | None => None end
1008 | uW :: X' =>
1009 match incXf n' X' with
1010 | None => None
1011 | Some (e1, x1) =>
1012 match incXf n' x1 with
1013 | None => None
1014 | Some (e2, x2) =>
1015 match incXf n' x2 with
1016 | None => None
1017 | Some (e3, x3) =>
1018 match shiftX x3 with
1019 | Some x4 => Some (e1 + e2 + e3, uP :: x4)
1020 | None => None
1021 end
1022 end
1023 end
1024 end
1025 end
1026 end.
1028Lemma incXf_sound n X e X' : incXf n X = Some (e, X') -> IncX X e X'.
1029Proof.
1030 revert X e X'; induction n as [|n IH]; intros X e X' H; [discriminate|].
1031 destruct X as [|u X]; cbn [incXf] in H.
1032 - inversion H; constructor.
1033 - destruct u.
1034 + inversion H; constructor.
1035 + destruct (incXf n X) as [[e0 x]|] eqn:E; inversion H; subst. constructor; auto.
1036 + destruct (incXf n X) as [[e0 x]|] eqn:E; inversion H; subst. constructor; auto.
1037 + inversion H; constructor.
1038 + inversion H; constructor.
1039 + destruct (incXf n X) as [[e1 x1]|] eqn:E1; [|discriminate].
1040 destruct (incXf n x1) as [[e2 x2]|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate].
1041 destruct (incXf n x2) as [[e3 x3]|] eqn:E3; [|discriminate].
1042 destruct (shiftX x3) as [x4|] eqn:E4; inversion H; subst.
1043 eapply IncX_W; eauto.
1044Qed.
1046Local Open Scope bool_scope.
1048(* ===================================================================== *)
1049(* 11. Binary words: bin v (least significant first, no trailing D0). *)
1050(* ===================================================================== *)
1052Fixpoint binp (p : positive) : list unt :=
1053 match p with
1054 | xH => [uD1]
1055 | xO p' => uD0 :: binp p'
1056 | xI p' => uD1 :: binp p'
1057 end.
1059Definition binN (n : N) : list unt := match n with N0 => [] | Npos p => binp p end.
1061Definition bin (v : nat) : list unt := binN (N.of_nat v).
1063Definition digN (n : N) : unt :=
1064 match n with
1065 | N0 => uD0
1066 | Npos xH => uD1
1067 | Npos (xO _) => uD0
1068 | Npos (xI _) => uD1
1069 end.
1071Lemma dig_even x : dig (2 * x) = uD0.
1072Proof. unfold dig. replace (2 * x) with (0 + x * 2) by lia. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. Qed.
1074Lemma dig_odd x : dig (2 * x + 1) = uD1.
1075Proof. unfold dig. replace (2 * x + 1) with (1 + x * 2) by lia. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. Qed.
1077Lemma digN_dig n : digN n = dig (N.to_nat n).
1078Proof.
1079 destruct n as [|[p|p|]]; cbn [digN].
1080 - reflexivity.
1081 - change (N.to_nat (Npos (xI p))) with (Pos.to_nat (xI p)). rewrite Pos2Nat.inj_xI. symmetry. replace (S (2 * Pos.to_nat p)) with (2 * Pos.to_nat p + 1) by lia.
1082 apply dig_odd.
1083 - change (N.to_nat (Npos (xO p))) with (Pos.to_nat (xO p)). rewrite Pos2Nat.inj_xO. symmetry. apply dig_even.
1084 - reflexivity.
1085Qed.
1087Lemma Inc_binp p : Inc (binp p) (binp (Pos.succ p)).
1088Proof.
1089 induction p as [p IH|p IH|]; cbn [binp Pos.succ].
1090 - constructor. exact IH.
1091 - constructor.
1092 - constructor. constructor.
1093Qed.
1095Lemma Inc_binN n : Inc (binN n) (binN (N.succ n)).
1096Proof. destruct n as [|p]; cbn. - constructor. - apply Inc_binp. Qed.
1098Lemma IncN_binN t n : IncN t (binN n) (binN (n + N.of_nat t)).
1099Proof.
1100 revert n; induction t as [|t IH]; intros n.
1101 - rewrite N.add_0_r. constructor.
1102 - econstructor; [apply Inc_binN|].
1103 replace (n + N.of_nat (S t))%N with (N.succ n + N.of_nat t)%N by lia. apply IH.
1104Qed.
1106Lemma IncN_bin t v : IncN t (bin v) (bin (v + t)).
1107Proof. unfold bin. rewrite Nat2N.inj_add. apply IncN_binN. Qed.
1109Lemma binN_eq n : binN n = if N.eqb n 0 then [] else digN n :: binN (N.div2 n).
1110Proof. destruct n as [|[p|p|]]; reflexivity. Qed.
1112Lemma bin_eq v : bin v = if Nat.eqb v 0 then [] else dig v :: bin (v / 2).
1113Proof.
1114 unfold bin. rewrite binN_eq. destruct v as [|v]; [reflexivity|].
1115 replace (N.eqb (N.of_nat (S v)) 0) with false by (symmetry; apply N.eqb_neq; lia). cbn [Nat.eqb].
1116 rewrite digN_dig, Nat2N.id. f_equal. f_equal.
1117 apply N2Nat.inj. rewrite N2Nat.inj_div2, !Nat2N.id, Nat.div2_div. reflexivity.
1118Qed.
1120Lemma bin_pos v : 0 < v -> bin v = dig v :: bin (v / 2).
1121Proof. intros H. rewrite bin_eq. destruct v; [lia|reflexivity]. Qed.
1123Lemma bin_0 : bin 0 = [].
1124Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
1126Lemma IncN_nil_bin t : IncN t [] (bin t).
1127Proof. pose proof (IncN_bin t 0) as H. exact H. Qed.
1129(* dig and division facts *)
1130Lemma dig_add_even v s : dig (v + 2 * s) = dig v.
1131Proof. unfold dig. replace (v + 2 * s) with (v + s * 2) by lia. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. Qed.
1133Lemma div2_add_even v s : (v + 2 * s) / 2 = v / 2 + s.
1134Proof. replace (v + 2 * s) with (v + s * 2) by lia. apply Nat.div_add. lia. Qed.
1136Lemma digits_app_bin n x y : x < 2 ^ n -> 0 < y -> digits n x ++ bin y = bin (x + 2 ^ n * y).
1137Proof.
1138 revert x y; induction n as [|n IH]; intros x y Hx Hy.
1139 - cbn in *. replace x with 0%nat by lia. f_equal. lia.
1140 - cbn [digits app]. rewrite (bin_pos (x + 2 ^ S n * y)).
1141 2:{ pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 (S n)). nia. }
1142 rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'.
1143 replace (x + 2 * 2 ^ n * y) with (x + 2 * (2 ^ n * y)) by lia.
1144 rewrite dig_add_even, div2_add_even. f_equal.
1145 apply IH; auto. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r' in Hx.
1146 apply Nat.Div0.div_lt_upper_bound. lia.
1147Qed.
1149Lemma bin_ones k q : bin (2 ^ k - 1 + 2 ^ (k + 1) * q) = repeat uD1 k ++ bin (2 * q).
1150Proof.
1151 induction k as [|k IH].
1152 - cbn [repeat app]. replace (2 ^ 0 - 1 + 2 ^ (0 + 1) * q) with (2 * q) by (cbn; lia). reflexivity.
1153 - pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 k).
1154 rewrite bin_pos.
1155 2:{ rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. lia. }
1156 replace (2 ^ S k - 1 + 2 ^ (S k + 1) * q) with (2 * (2 ^ k - 1 + 2 ^ (k + 1) * q) + 1).
1157 2:{ rewrite !Nat.pow_succ_r', !Nat.pow_add_r. cbn. lia. }
1158 rewrite dig_odd. cbn [repeat app]. f_equal.
1159 rewrite <- IH. f_equal.
1160 replace (2 * (2 ^ k - 1 + 2 ^ (k + 1) * q) + 1) with (1 + (2 ^ k - 1 + 2 ^ (k + 1) * q) * 2) by lia.
1161 rewrite Nat.div_add by lia. reflexivity.
1162Qed.
1164(* digit-only words *)
1165Fixpoint allb (f : unt -> bool) (w : list unt) : bool :=
1166 match w with [] => true | u :: w' => f u && allb f w' end.
1168Fixpoint ndig (X : list unt) : nat :=
1169 match X with [] => O | u :: X' => (if isdig u then 1 else 0) + ndig X' end.
1171Fixpoint val (X : list unt) : nat :=
1172 match X with [] => O | u :: X' => if isdig u then dval u + 2 * val X' else val X' end.
1174Lemma digits_val Xd : allb isdig Xd = true -> Xd = digits (length Xd) (val Xd).
1175Proof.
1176 induction Xd as [|u Xd IH]; intros H; [reflexivity|].
1177 cbn [allb] in H. apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [Hu H].
1178 cbn [length digits val]. rewrite Hu.
1179 f_equal.
1180 - destruct u; try discriminate; cbn [dval].
1181 + rewrite Nat.add_0_l. symmetry. apply dig_even.
1182 + rewrite Nat.add_comm. symmetry. apply dig_odd.
1183 - rewrite div2_add_even. replace (dval u / 2) with 0%nat.
1184 + apply IH; auto.
1185 + destruct u; reflexivity.
1186Qed.
1188Lemma val_lt Xd : allb isdig Xd = true -> val Xd < 2 ^ length Xd.
1189Proof.
1190 induction Xd as [|u Xd IH]; intros H; cbn; [lia|].
1191 apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [Hu H]. rewrite Hu.
1192 specialize (IH H). assert (dval u <= 1) by (destruct u; cbn; lia). lia.
1193Qed.
1195(* ===================================================================== *)
1196(* 12. Carries through a cut: XN t X e X' says that t carries on X ++ Y *)
1197(* give X' ++ Y' whenever e carries on Y give Y' (every shift lands *)
1198(* inside X). *)
1199(* ===================================================================== *)
1201Definition XN (t : nat) (X : list unt) (e : nat) (X' : list unt) : Prop :=
1202 forall Y Y', IncN e Y Y' -> IncN t (X ++ Y) (X' ++ Y').
1204Lemma XN_0 X : XN 0 X 0 X.
1205Proof. intros Y Y' H. inversion H; subst. constructor. Qed.
1207Lemma XN_nil t : XN t [] t [].
1208Proof. intros Y Y' H. exact H. Qed.
1210Lemma XN_add a b X e1 X1 e2 X2 : XN a X e1 X1 -> XN b X1 e2 X2 -> XN (a + b) X (e1 + e2) X2.
1211Proof.
1212 intros H1 H2 Y Y' H. destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ H) as [Y1 [Ha Hb]].
1213 eapply IncN_add; [apply H1; exact Ha | apply H2; exact Hb].
1214Qed.
1216Lemma XN_P t X e X' : XN t X e X' -> XN t (uP :: X) e (uP :: X').
1217Proof. intros H Y Y' HY. cbn [app]. apply IncN_P. apply H. exact HY. Qed.
1219Lemma XN_digit t u X e X' : isdig u = true -> XN ((dval u + t) / 2) X e X' ->
1220 XN t (u :: X) e (dig (dval u + t) :: X').
1221Proof. intros Hu H Y Y' HY. cbn [app]. apply IncN_digit; auto. Qed.
1223Lemma XN_S1 t X e X' : XN t X e X' -> XN (S t) (uS1 :: X) e (uP :: X').
1224Proof. intros H Y Y' HY. cbn [app]. econstructor; [constructor|]. apply IncN_P. apply H. exact HY. Qed.
1226Lemma XN_SP t X e X' : XN t (uW :: X) e X' -> XN (S t) (uSP :: X) e X'.
1227Proof. intros H Y Y' HY. cbn [app]. econstructor; [constructor|]. apply (H Y Y' HY). Qed.
1229Lemma XN_W t X e1 X1 X2 e2 X3 : XN 3 X e1 X1 -> shiftX X1 = Some X2 -> XN t X2 e2 X3 ->
1230 XN (S t) (uW :: X) (e1 + e2) (uP :: X3).
1231Proof.
1232 intros H1 Hs H2 Y Y' HY. destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ HY) as [Y1 [Ha Hb]].
1233 specialize (H1 _ _ Ha). destruct (IncN_3_inv _ _ H1) as [a [b [Ha1 [Ha2 Ha3]]]].
1234 cbn [app]. econstructor.
1235 - eapply Inc_W; [exact Ha1|exact Ha2|exact Ha3|]. apply shiftX_app. exact Hs.
1236 - apply IncN_P. apply H2. exact Hb.
1237Qed.
1239(* the executable bulk feed, with N counts *)
1240Fixpoint xfeed (f : nat) (t : N) (X : list unt) : option (list unt * N) :=
1241 match f with
1242 | O => None
1243 | S f' =>
1244 if N.eqb t 0 then Some (X, 0%N) else
1245 match X with
1246 | [] => Some ([], t)
1247 | uD0 :: X' =>
1248 match xfeed f' (N.div2 t) X' with Some (X'', e) => Some (digN t :: X'', e) | None => None end
1249 | uD1 :: X' =>
1250 match xfeed f' (N.div2 (N.succ t)) X' with
1251 | Some (X'', e) => Some (digN (N.succ t) :: X'', e) | None => None end
1252 | uP :: X' => match xfeed f' t X' with Some (X'', e) => Some (uP :: X'', e) | None => None end
1253 | uS1 :: X' => match xfeed f' (N.pred t) X' with Some (X'', e) => Some (uP :: X'', e) | None => None end
1254 | uSP :: X' => xfeed f' (N.pred t) (uW :: X')
1255 | uW :: X' =>
1256 match xfeed f' 3 X' with
1257 | Some (X1, e1) =>
1258 match shiftX X1 with
1259 | Some X2 =>
1260 match xfeed f' (N.pred t) X2 with
1261 | Some (X3, e2) => Some (uP :: X3, (e1 + e2)%N)
1262 | None => None
1263 end
1264 | None => None
1265 end
1266 | None => None
1267 end
1268 end
1269 end.
1271Lemma xfeed_sound f t X X' e : xfeed f t X = Some (X', e) -> XN (N.to_nat t) X (N.to_nat e) X'.
1272Proof.
1273 revert t X X' e; induction f as [|f IH]; intros t X X' e H; [discriminate|].
1274 cbn [xfeed] in H.
1275 destruct (N.eqb t 0) eqn:Et.
1276 { apply N.eqb_eq in Et. subst. inversion H; subst. apply XN_0. }
1277 apply N.eqb_neq in Et.
1278 assert (Ht : N.to_nat t = S (N.to_nat (N.pred t))) by lia.
1279 destruct X as [|u X0].
1280 { inversion H; subst. apply XN_nil. }
1281 destruct u.
1282 - destruct (xfeed f (N.div2 t) X0) as [[X'' e']|] eqn:E; inversion H; subst.
1283 rewrite digN_dig.
1284 replace (N.to_nat t) with (dval uD0 + N.to_nat t) at 2 by reflexivity.
1285 apply XN_digit; [reflexivity|].
1286 cbn [dval]. rewrite Nat.add_0_l, <- Nat.div2_div, <- N2Nat.inj_div2. apply IH. exact E.
1287 - destruct (xfeed f (N.div2 (N.succ t)) X0) as [[X'' e']|] eqn:E; inversion H; subst.
1288 rewrite digN_dig, N2Nat.inj_succ.
1289 apply XN_digit; [reflexivity|].
1290 cbn [dval]. replace (1 + N.to_nat t) with (N.to_nat (N.succ t)) by lia.
1291 rewrite <- Nat.div2_div, <- N2Nat.inj_div2. apply IH. exact E.
1292 - destruct (xfeed f t X0) as [[X'' e']|] eqn:E; inversion H; subst.
1293 apply XN_P. apply IH. exact E.
1294 - destruct (xfeed f (N.pred t) X0) as [[X'' e']|] eqn:E; inversion H; subst.
1295 rewrite Ht. apply XN_S1. apply IH. exact E.
1296 - rewrite Ht. apply XN_SP. apply IH. exact H.
1297 - destruct (xfeed f 3 X0) as [[X1 e1]|] eqn:E1; [|discriminate].
1298 destruct (shiftX X1) as [X2|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate].
1299 destruct (xfeed f (N.pred t) X2) as [[X3 e2]|] eqn:E3; inversion H; subst.
1300 rewrite Ht, N2Nat.inj_add. eapply XN_W.
1301 + apply IH in E1. exact E1.
1302 + exact E2.
1303 + apply IH. exact E3.
1304Qed.
1306(* ===================================================================== *)
1307(* 13. Clean words (D0, D1, P only) are counters: the P units pass. *)
1308(* ===================================================================== *)
1310Fixpoint fill (X : list unt) (v : nat) : list unt :=
1311 match X with
1312 | [] => []
1313 | u :: X' => if isdig u then dig v :: fill X' (v / 2) else u :: fill X' v
1314 end.
1316Definition cleanu (u : unt) : bool := match u with uD0 | uD1 | uP => true | _ => false end.
1318Lemma XN_clean X t : allb cleanu X = true ->
1319 XN t X ((val X + t) / 2 ^ ndig X) (fill X (val X + t)).
1320Proof.
1321 revert t; induction X as [|u X IH]; intros t H.
1322 - cbn [val ndig fill]. rewrite Nat.pow_0_r, Nat.add_0_l, Nat.div_1_r. apply XN_nil.
1323 - cbn [allb] in H. apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [Hu H].
1324 destruct u; try discriminate; cbn [ndig val fill isdig].
1325 + (* D0 *)
1326 replace (dig (dval uD0 + 2 * val X + t)) with (dig (dval uD0 + t)).
1327 2:{ replace (dval uD0 + 2 * val X + t) with ((dval uD0 + t) + 2 * val X) by lia.
1328 symmetry. apply dig_add_even. }
1329 replace ((dval uD0 + 2 * val X + t) / 2) with (val X + (dval uD0 + t) / 2).
1330 2:{ replace (dval uD0 + 2 * val X + t) with ((dval uD0 + t) + 2 * val X) by lia.
1331 rewrite div2_add_even. lia. }
1332 replace ((dval uD0 + 2 * val X + t) / 2 ^ (1 + ndig X)) with ((val X + (dval uD0 + t) / 2) / 2 ^ ndig X).
1333 2:{ rewrite Nat.pow_add_r, Nat.pow_1_r, <- Nat.Div0.div_div.
1334 replace (dval uD0 + 2 * val X + t) with ((dval uD0 + t) + 2 * val X) by lia.
1335 rewrite div2_add_even. f_equal. lia. }
1336 apply XN_digit; [reflexivity|]. apply IH. exact H.
1337 + (* D1 *)
1338 replace (dig (dval uD1 + 2 * val X + t)) with (dig (dval uD1 + t)).
1339 2:{ replace (dval uD1 + 2 * val X + t) with ((dval uD1 + t) + 2 * val X) by lia.
1340 symmetry. apply dig_add_even. }
1341 replace ((dval uD1 + 2 * val X + t) / 2) with (val X + (dval uD1 + t) / 2).
1342 2:{ replace (dval uD1 + 2 * val X + t) with ((dval uD1 + t) + 2 * val X) by lia.
1343 rewrite div2_add_even. lia. }
1344 replace ((dval uD1 + 2 * val X + t) / 2 ^ (1 + ndig X)) with ((val X + (dval uD1 + t) / 2) / 2 ^ ndig X).
1345 2:{ rewrite Nat.pow_add_r, Nat.pow_1_r, <- Nat.Div0.div_div.
1346 replace (dval uD1 + 2 * val X + t) with ((dval uD1 + t) + 2 * val X) by lia.
1347 rewrite div2_add_even. f_equal. lia. }
1348 apply XN_digit; [reflexivity|]. apply IH. exact H.
1349 + (* P *)
1350 rewrite Nat.add_0_l. apply XN_P. apply IH. exact H.
1351Qed.
1353Lemma fill_mod X v s : fill X (v + 2 ^ ndig X * s) = fill X v.
1354Proof.
1355 revert v; induction X as [|u X IH]; intros v; cbn [fill ndig]; [reflexivity|].
1356 destruct (isdig u) eqn:Hu.
1357 - rewrite Nat.pow_add_r, Nat.pow_1_r.
1358 replace (v + 2 * 2 ^ ndig X * s) with (v + 2 * (2 ^ ndig X * s)) by lia.
1359 rewrite dig_add_even, div2_add_even, IH. reflexivity.
1360 - rewrite Nat.add_0_l, IH. reflexivity.
1361Qed.
1363Lemma div_mod_shift v n s : (v + 2 ^ n * s) / 2 ^ n = v / 2 ^ n + s.
1364Proof.
1365 pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 n).
1366 replace (v + 2 ^ n * s) with (v + s * 2 ^ n) by lia. apply Nat.div_add. lia.
1367Qed.
1369(* digit heads stay digit heads *)
1370Definition dhead (w : list unt) : bool := match w with uD0 :: _ | uD1 :: _ => true | _ => false end.
1372Lemma Inc_dhead w w' : dhead w = true -> Inc w w' -> dhead w' = true.
1373Proof. intros H Hi. destruct Hi; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity. Qed.
1375Lemma IncN_dhead n w w' : dhead w = true -> IncN n w w' -> dhead w' = true.
1376Proof. intros H Hi. induction Hi; auto. apply IHHi. eapply Inc_dhead; eauto. Qed.
1378Lemma dhead_app X Y : dhead X = true -> dhead (X ++ Y) = true.
1379Proof. intros H. destruct X as [|[] X]; cbn in *; auto; discriminate. Qed.
1381Lemma dhead_notP w : dhead w = true -> notP w.
1382Proof. destruct w as [|[] w]; cbn; auto; discriminate. Qed.
1384(* ===================================================================== *)
1385(* 14. One closed-system step through a cut (the locality step). *)
1386(* Phase 1: the first T0 carries act on X alone (all drops happen *)
1387(* there); phase 2: the rest; the absorption shift. *)
1388(* ===================================================================== *)
1390Lemma cutstep X Y T0 e1 A X1 c e2 X2 D j Z' Y' :
1391 XN T0 X e1 (Ps A ++ X1) -> dhead X1 = true ->
1392 XN (c + 3 * A - T0) X1 e2 X2 -> T0 <= c -> c = D + pj j ->
1393 IncN (e1 + e2) Y Y' -> shift (X2 ++ Y') = Some Z' ->
1394 cs_step (X ++ Y) D j Z' (D + A) (S j).
1395Proof.
1396 intros H1 Hd H2 HT Hc HY Hs.
1397 destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ HY) as [Y1 [HY1 HY2]].
1398 specialize (H1 _ _ HY1). specialize (H2 _ _ HY2).
1399 assert (Hd2 : dhead (X2 ++ Y') = true).
1400 { eapply IncN_dhead; [|exact H2]. apply dhead_app. exact Hd. }
1401 exists (c + 3 * A), A, (X2 ++ Y').
1402 split; [|split; [|split; [|split; [|split]]]].
1403 - replace (c + 3 * A) with (T0 + (c + 3 * A - T0)) by lia.
1404 eapply IncN_add; [exact H1|]. rewrite <- app_assoc. apply IncN_Ps. exact H2.
1405 - apply dhead_notP. exact Hd2.
1406 - lia.
1407 - intros m' A' Y'' Hm Hi HN.
1408 destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases m' T0) as [Hlt|Hge]; [lia|].
1409 replace m' with (T0 + (m' - T0)) in Hi by lia.
1410 destruct (IncN_split _ _ _ _ Hi) as [w1 [Hw1 Hw2]].
1411 assert (w1 = (Ps A ++ X1) ++ Y1) by (eapply IncN_det; eauto). subst w1.
1412 rewrite <- app_assoc in Hw2.
1413 destruct (IncN_Ps_inv _ _ _ _ Hw2) as [y' [Ey' Hy']].
1414 assert (Hdy : dhead y' = true) by (eapply IncN_dhead; [apply dhead_app; exact Hd|exact Hy']).
1415 destruct (Ps_notP_inj _ _ _ _ Ey' HN (dhead_notP _ Hdy)) as [EA _]. lia.
1416 - exact Hs.
1417 - split; reflexivity.
1418Qed.
1420(* ===================================================================== *)
1421(* 15. Affine families of closed-system states and their runner. *)
1422(* A family stands for the states, for every u, *)
1423(* zone X ++ bin (y + ay u), D = D0 + aD u, j = j0 + aD u. *)
1424(* ===================================================================== *)
1426Record fam := mkF { fX : list unt; fy : N; fay : N; fD : N; fj : N; faD : N }.
1428Definition st : Type := (list unt * nat * nat)%type.
1430Definition fz (F : fam) (u : nat) : st :=
1431 (fX F ++ bin (N.to_nat (fy F) + N.to_nat (fay F) * u),
1432 N.to_nat (fD F) + N.to_nat (faD F) * u,
1433 N.to_nat (fj F) + N.to_nat (faD F) * u).
1435Definition CS (s s' : st) : Prop :=
1436 cs_step (fst (fst s)) (snd (fst s)) (snd s) (fst (fst s')) (snd (fst s')) (snd s').
1438Inductive CSplus : st -> st -> Prop :=
1439| CSp1 s s' : CS s s' -> CSplus s s'
1440| CSpS s s1 s' : CS s s1 -> CSplus s1 s' -> CSplus s s'.
1442Lemma CSplus_trans a b c : CSplus a b -> CSplus b c -> CSplus a c.
1443Proof. induction 1 as [x y Hs|x y z Hs H1 IH]; intros Hn; [eapply CSpS; eauto|]. eapply CSpS; eauto. Qed.
1445Lemma CS_j s s' : CS s s' -> snd s' = S (snd s).
1446Proof.
1447 destruct s as [[z d] j], s' as [[z' d'] j']. unfold CS. cbn.
1448 intros [m [a [y [_ [_ [_ [_ [_ [_ E]]]]]]]]]. exact E.
1449Qed.
1451Lemma CSplus_j a b : CSplus a b -> snd a < snd b.
1452Proof. induction 1 as [x y Hs|x y z Hs H1 IH]; apply CS_j in Hs; lia. Qed.
1454Definition pjN (j : N) : N := N.of_nat (pj (N.to_nat (j mod 8))).
1456Lemma pj_mod j : pj j = pj (j mod 8).
1457Proof. unfold pj. rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_mod. reflexivity. Qed.
1459Lemma pjN_spec j : N.to_nat (pjN j) = pj (N.to_nat j).
1460Proof. unfold pjN. rewrite Nat2N.id, N2Nat.inj_mod. rewrite (pj_mod (N.to_nat j)). reflexivity. Qed.
1462Lemma pj_add8 j a : a mod 8 = O -> forall u, pj (j + a * u) = pj j.
1463Proof.
1464 intros Ha u. rewrite (pj_mod (j + a * u)), (pj_mod j). f_equal.
1465 apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in Ha. destruct Ha as [g Hg]. subst a.
1466 replace (j + 8 * g * u) with (j + (g * u) * 8) by lia. apply Nat.Div0.mod_add.
1467Qed.
1469Fixpoint valN (X : list unt) : N :=
1470 match X with
1471 | [] => 0%N
1472 | u :: X' => if isdig u then (N.of_nat (dval u) + 2 * valN X')%N else valN X'
1473 end.
1475Lemma valN_spec X : N.to_nat (valN X) = val X.
1476Proof.
1477 induction X as [|u X IH]; cbn [valN val]; [reflexivity|].
1478 destruct (isdig u); [|exact IH].
1479 rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, N2Nat.inj_mul, Nat2N.id, IH. reflexivity.
1480Qed.
1482Fixpoint fillN (X : list unt) (v : N) : list unt :=
1483 match X with
1484 | [] => []
1485 | u :: X' => if isdig u then digN v :: fillN X' (N.div2 v) else u :: fillN X' v
1486 end.
1488Lemma fillN_spec X v : fillN X v = fill X (N.to_nat v).
1489Proof.
1490 revert v; induction X as [|u X IH]; intros v; cbn; [reflexivity|].
1491 destruct (isdig u); rewrite IH; [|reflexivity].
1492 rewrite digN_dig, N2Nat.inj_div2, Nat.div2_div. reflexivity.
1493Qed.
1495Fixpoint fnorm (n : nat) (F : fam) : fam :=
1496 match n with
1497 | O => F
1498 | S n' =>
1499 if N.even (fay F) && N.ltb 0 (fy F) then
1500 fnorm n' (mkF (fX F ++ [digN (fy F)]) (N.div2 (fy F)) (N.div2 (fay F)) (fD F) (fj F) (faD F))
1501 else F
1502 end.
1504Lemma fnorm_spec n F u : fz (fnorm n F) u = fz F u.
1505Proof.
1506 revert F; induction n as [|n IH]; intros F; cbn [fnorm]; [reflexivity|].
1507 destruct (N.even (fay F) && N.ltb 0 (fy F)) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
1508 apply andb_prop in E. destruct E as [Ee Ey]. apply N.ltb_lt in Ey.
1509 rewrite IH. unfold fz. cbn [fX fy fay fD fj faD].
1510 f_equal. f_equal.
1511 apply N.even_spec in Ee. destruct Ee as [g Hg].
1512 rewrite <- app_assoc. f_equal.
1513 rewrite (bin_pos (N.to_nat (fy F) + N.to_nat (fay F) * u)) by lia.
1514 rewrite Hg. rewrite !N2Nat.inj_div2, !Nat.div2_div, N2Nat.inj_mul.
1515 replace (N.to_nat (fy F) + N.to_nat 2 * N.to_nat g * u) with (N.to_nat (fy F) + 2 * (N.to_nat g * u)) by (cbn; lia).
1516 rewrite dig_add_even, div2_add_even, digN_dig.
1517 replace (N.to_nat 2 * N.to_nat g / 2) with (N.to_nat g).
1518 - reflexivity.
1519 - replace (N.to_nat 2 * N.to_nat g) with (0 + N.to_nat g * 2) by (cbn; lia).
1520 rewrite Nat.div_add by lia. reflexivity.
1521Qed.
1523Definition n3 (a : nat) : N := N.of_nat (3 * a).
1525Lemma n3_spec a : N.to_nat (n3 a) = 3 * a.
1526Proof. unfold n3. apply Nat2N.id. Qed.
1528Definition phase2 (F : fam) (X1 : list unt) (a : nat) : option (list unt * N * N) :=
1529 let nd := N.of_nat (ndig X1) in
1530 if allb cleanu X1 then
1531 let v := (valN X1 + n3 a)%N in
1532 Some (fillN X1 v, (v / 2 ^ nd)%N, (fay F + faD F / 2 ^ nd)%N)
1533 else if N.eqb (faD F) 0 then
1534 match xfeed 4000 (n3 a) X1 with
1535 | Some (X2, e2) => Some (X2, e2, fay F)
1536 | None => None
1537 end
1538 else None.
1540Definition fstep (R : nat) (F : fam) : option fam :=
1541 if negb (N.eqb (faD F mod 8) 0) then None else
1542 match xfeed 4000 (fD F + pjN (fj F)) (fX F) with
1543 | None => None
1544 | Some (Xt, e1) =>
1545 let (a, X1) := splitP Xt in
1546 if negb (dhead X1) then None else
1547 if negb (N.eqb (faD F mod 2 ^ N.of_nat (ndig X1)) 0) then None else
1548 match phase2 F X1 a with
1549 | None => None
1550 | Some (X2, e2, ay2) =>
1551 let y2 := (fy F + e1 + e2)%N in
1552 match shiftX X2 with
1553 | Some X3 => Some (fnorm (R - ndig X3) (mkF X3 y2 ay2 (fD F + N.of_nat a) (N.succ (fj F)) (faD F)))
1554 | None =>
1555 if N.eqb ay2 0 && N.eqb (faD F) 0 then
1556 match shift (X2 ++ binN y2) with
1557 | Some Z3 => Some (mkF Z3 0 0 (fD F + N.of_nat a) (N.succ (fj F)) (faD F))
1558 | None => None
1559 end
1560 else None
1561 end
1562 end
1563 end.
1565Lemma phase2_sound F X1 a X2 e2 ay2 u :
1566 phase2 F X1 a = Some (X2, e2, ay2) ->
1567 N.to_nat (faD F) mod 2 ^ ndig X1 = O ->
1568 XN (3 * a + N.to_nat (faD F) * u) X1 (N.to_nat e2 + (N.to_nat ay2 - N.to_nat (fay F)) * u) X2 /\
1569 N.to_nat (fay F) <= N.to_nat ay2.
1570Proof.
1571 unfold phase2. intros H Hdiv.
1572 destruct (allb cleanu X1) eqn:Ec.
1573 - injection H as <- <- <-.
1574 apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in Hdiv. destruct Hdiv as [g Hg].
1575 assert (Hp : N.to_nat (2 ^ N.of_nat (ndig X1)) = 2 ^ ndig X1).
1576 { rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id. reflexivity. }
1577 assert (Hg' : N.to_nat (faD F / 2 ^ N.of_nat (ndig X1)) = g).
1578 { rewrite N2Nat.inj_div, Hp, Hg. rewrite Nat.mul_comm, Nat.div_mul; [reflexivity|].
1579 apply Nat.pow_nonzero. lia. }
1580 split; [|rewrite N2Nat.inj_add; lia].
1581 rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, Hg'.
1582 replace (N.to_nat (fay F) + g - N.to_nat (fay F)) with g by lia.
1583 rewrite fillN_spec, !N2Nat.inj_div, !Hp, !N2Nat.inj_add, !n3_spec, !valN_spec.
1584 pose proof (XN_clean X1 (3 * a + N.to_nat (faD F) * u) Ec) as G.
1585 rewrite Hg in G.
1586 replace (val X1 + (3 * a + 2 ^ ndig X1 * g * u)) with ((val X1 + 3 * a) + 2 ^ ndig X1 * (g * u)) in G by lia.
1587 rewrite fill_mod, div_mod_shift in G.
1588 rewrite Hg. exact G.
1589 - destruct (N.eqb (faD F) 0) eqn:E0; [|discriminate].
1590 apply N.eqb_eq in E0. rewrite E0. cbn [N.to_nat].
1591 destruct (xfeed 4000 (n3 a) X1) as [[X2' e2']|] eqn:Ex; [|discriminate].
1592 injection H as <- <- <-.
1593 split; [|lia].
1594 apply xfeed_sound in Ex. rewrite n3_spec in Ex.
1595 replace (3 * a + 0 * u) with (3 * a) by lia.
1596 replace (N.to_nat e2' + (N.to_nat (fay F) - N.to_nat (fay F)) * u) with (N.to_nat e2') by lia.
1597 exact Ex.
1598Qed.
1600Lemma if_negb_true A (x y : A) : (if negb true then x else y) = y.
1601Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
1603(* PITFALL: [cbn in H] on the unfolded fstep makes Qed hang (kernel conversion);
1604 rewriting with [if_negb_true] is instant. *)
1605Lemma fstep_sound R F F' : fstep R F = Some F' -> forall u, CS (fz F u) (fz F' u).
1606Proof.
1607 unfold fstep. intros H u.
1608 destruct (N.eqb (faD F mod 8) 0) eqn:E8; [|discriminate]. rewrite if_negb_true in H.
1609 apply N.eqb_eq in E8.
1610 destruct (xfeed 4000 (fD F + pjN (fj F)) (fX F)) as [[Xt e1]|] eqn:Ex; [|discriminate].
1611 pose proof (splitP_spec Xt) as HS. destruct (splitP Xt) as [a X1].
1612 destruct HS as [EXt _].
1613 destruct (dhead X1) eqn:Ed; [|discriminate]. rewrite if_negb_true in H.
1614 destruct (N.eqb (faD F mod 2 ^ N.of_nat (ndig X1)) 0) eqn:Em; [|discriminate]. rewrite if_negb_true in H.
1615 apply N.eqb_eq in Em.
1616 assert (Hdiv : N.to_nat (faD F) mod 2 ^ ndig X1 = O).
1617 { replace (2 ^ ndig X1) with (N.to_nat (2 ^ N.of_nat (ndig X1))) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id; reflexivity).
1618 rewrite <- N2Nat.inj_mod, Em. reflexivity. }
1619 destruct (phase2 F X1 a) as [[[X2 e2] ay2]|] eqn:Ep; [|discriminate].
1620 destruct (phase2_sound F X1 a X2 e2 ay2 u Ep Hdiv) as [HX2 Hay].
1621 apply xfeed_sound in Ex. rewrite EXt in Ex.
1622 assert (H8 : N.to_nat (faD F) mod 8 = O).
1623 { replace 8 with (N.to_nat 8) by reflexivity. rewrite <- N2Nat.inj_mod, E8. reflexivity. }
1624 set (aD := N.to_nat (faD F)) in *.
1625 set (D0 := N.to_nat (fD F)). set (j0 := N.to_nat (fj F)).
1626 assert (Hc : N.to_nat (fD F + pjN (fj F)) + aD * u = (D0 + aD * u) + pj (j0 + aD * u)).
1627 { rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, pjN_spec. fold D0 j0. rewrite pj_add8 by exact H8. lia. }
1628 set (y0 := N.to_nat (fy F)) in *. set (ay := N.to_nat (fay F)) in *.
1629 assert (HY : IncN (N.to_nat e1 + (N.to_nat e2 + (N.to_nat ay2 - ay) * u))
1630 (bin (y0 + ay * u)) (bin (N.to_nat (fy F + e1 + e2) + N.to_nat ay2 * u))).
1631 { replace (N.to_nat (fy F + e1 + e2) + N.to_nat ay2 * u)
1632 with ((y0 + ay * u) + (N.to_nat e1 + (N.to_nat e2 + (N.to_nat ay2 - ay) * u))).
1633 - apply IncN_bin.
1634 - rewrite !N2Nat.inj_add. fold y0. rewrite Nat.mul_sub_distr_r.
1635 assert (ay * u <= N.to_nat ay2 * u) by (apply Nat.mul_le_mono_r; exact Hay). lia. }
1636 assert (Hstep : forall Z', shift (X2 ++ bin (N.to_nat (fy F + e1 + e2) + N.to_nat ay2 * u)) = Some Z' ->
1637 cs_step (fX F ++ bin (y0 + ay * u)) (D0 + aD * u) (j0 + aD * u) Z'
1638 (D0 + aD * u + a) (S (j0 + aD * u))).
1639 { intros Z' Hs.
1640 apply (cutstep (fX F) (bin (y0 + ay * u)) (N.to_nat (fD F + pjN (fj F))) (N.to_nat e1) a X1
1641 (D0 + aD * u + pj (j0 + aD * u)) (N.to_nat e2 + (N.to_nat ay2 - ay) * u) X2
1642 (D0 + aD * u) (j0 + aD * u) Z' (bin (N.to_nat (fy F + e1 + e2) + N.to_nat ay2 * u))).
1643 - exact Ex.
1644 - exact Ed.
1645 - replace ((D0 + aD * u + pj (j0 + aD * u)) + 3 * a - N.to_nat (fD F + pjN (fj F)))
1646 with (3 * a + aD * u) by (clear -Hc; lia).
1647 exact HX2.
1648 - clear -Hc. lia.
1649 - reflexivity.
1650 - exact HY.
1651 - exact Hs. }
1652 clear Hdiv H8 Em E8 HY Hc HX2 Hay Ex.
1653 destruct (shiftX X2) as [X3|] eqn:Es.
1654 - inversion H; subst. clear H. unfold CS. rewrite fnorm_spec. unfold fz. cbn [fst snd fX fy fay fD fj faD].
1655 fold aD D0 j0 y0 ay.
1656 replace (N.to_nat (fD F + N.of_nat a) + aD * u) with (D0 + aD * u + a) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, Nat2N.id; lia).
1657 replace (N.to_nat (N.succ (fj F)) + aD * u) with (S (j0 + aD * u)) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_succ; lia).
1658 apply Hstep. apply shiftX_app. exact Es.
1659 - destruct (N.eqb ay2 0 && N.eqb (faD F) 0) eqn:Ec; [|discriminate].
1660 apply andb_prop in Ec. destruct Ec as [Ea Eb]. apply N.eqb_eq in Ea, Eb.
1661 destruct (shift (X2 ++ binN (fy F + e1 + e2))) as [Z3|] eqn:Ez; inversion H; subst. clear H.
1662 unfold CS, fz. cbn [fst snd fX fy fay fD fj faD].
1663 fold aD D0 j0 y0 ay.
1664 assert (HaD : aD = O) by (unfold aD; rewrite Eb; reflexivity).
1665 replace (N.to_nat (fD F + N.of_nat a) + aD * u) with (D0 + aD * u + a) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, Nat2N.id; lia).
1666 replace (N.to_nat (N.succ (fj F)) + aD * u) with (S (j0 + aD * u)) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_succ; lia).
1667 cbn [N.to_nat] in *. rewrite Nat.mul_0_l, Nat.add_0_l, bin_0, app_nil_r.
1668 apply Hstep. rewrite Nat.mul_0_l, Nat.add_0_r.
1669 unfold bin. rewrite N2Nat.id. exact Ez.
1670Qed.
1672(* canonical states C(b) = S1 D0 D1^4 bin(b + 1), D = 32b + 16, j = 32b + 17 *)
1673Definition Cst (b : nat) : st := ([uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] ++ bin (S b), 32 * b + 16, 32 * b + 17).
1675Definition unt_eq_dec (a b : unt) : {a = b} + {a <> b}.
1676Proof. decide equality. Defined.
1678Definition lsteqb (l1 l2 : list unt) : bool := if list_eq_dec unt_eq_dec l1 l2 then true else false.
1680Definition canonb (F : fam) : bool :=
1681 match fX F with
1682 | uS1 :: uD0 :: uD1 :: uD1 :: uD1 :: uD1 :: Xd =>
1683 allb isdig Xd && N.leb 17 (fj F) && N.eqb ((fj F - 17) mod 32) 0 && N.eqb (fD F + 1) (fj F) &&
1684 N.eqb (faD F mod 32) 0 &&
1685 (if N.eqb (fay F) 0 && N.eqb (faD F) 0 then lsteqb (Xd ++ binN (fy F)) (binN ((fj F - 17) / 32 + 1))
1686 else N.ltb 0 (fy F) &&
1687 N.eqb (valN Xd + 2 ^ N.of_nat (length Xd) * fy F) ((fj F - 17) / 32 + 1) &&
1688 N.eqb (2 ^ N.of_nat (length Xd) * fay F) (faD F / 32))
1689 | _ => false
1690 end.
1692Lemma canonb_sound F : canonb F = true -> exists b0 g, forall u, fz F u = Cst (b0 + g * u).
1693Proof.
1694 unfold canonb. destruct (fX F) as [|[] [|[] [|[] [|[] [|[] [|[] Xd]]]]]] eqn:EX; try discriminate.
1695 intros H.
1696 apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [H Hf].
1697 apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [H He].
1698 apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [H Hd].
1699 apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [H Hc].
1700 apply andb_prop in H. destruct H as [Ha Hb].
1701 apply N.leb_le in Hb. apply N.eqb_eq in Hc, Hd, He.
1702 exists (N.to_nat ((fj F - 17) / 32)), (N.to_nat (faD F / 32)). intros u.
1703 assert (E1 : N.to_nat (fj F - 17) mod 32 = O).
1704 { replace 32 with (N.to_nat 32) by reflexivity. rewrite <- N2Nat.inj_mod, Hc. reflexivity. }
1705 assert (E2 : N.to_nat (faD F) mod 32 = O).
1706 { replace 32 with (N.to_nat 32) by reflexivity. rewrite <- N2Nat.inj_mod, He. reflexivity. }
1707 assert (Hb' : 17 <= N.to_nat (fj F)) by lia.
1708 assert (Hd' : N.to_nat (fD F) + 1 = N.to_nat (fj F)) by (rewrite <- Hd; rewrite N2Nat.inj_add; reflexivity).
1709 rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub in E1.
1710 apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in E1, E2. destruct E1 as [p Hp], E2 as [q Hq].
1711 replace (N.to_nat 17) with 17 in Hp by reflexivity.
1712 assert (Ebj : N.to_nat ((fj F - 17) / 32) = p).
1713 { rewrite N2Nat.inj_div, N2Nat.inj_sub. replace (N.to_nat 17) with 17 by reflexivity.
1714 replace (N.to_nat 32) with 32 by reflexivity. rewrite Hp. rewrite Nat.mul_comm, Nat.div_mul; lia. }
1715 assert (Eg : N.to_nat (faD F / 32) = q).
1716 { rewrite N2Nat.inj_div. replace (N.to_nat 32) with 32 by reflexivity. rewrite Hq.
1717 rewrite Nat.mul_comm, Nat.div_mul; lia. }
1718 rewrite Ebj, Eg.
1719 unfold fz, Cst. rewrite EX. cbn [app].
1720 f_equal; [f_equal|].
1721 - do 6 f_equal.
1722 destruct (N.eqb (fay F) 0 && N.eqb (faD F) 0) eqn:Ec.
1723 + apply andb_prop in Ec. destruct Ec as [Ea Eb]. apply N.eqb_eq in Ea, Eb.
1724 unfold lsteqb in Hf.
1725 destruct (list_eq_dec unt_eq_dec (Xd ++ binN (fy F)) (binN ((fj F - 17) / 32 + 1))) as [Eq|]; [|discriminate].
1726 rewrite Ea, Eb in *. cbn [N.to_nat] in *. rewrite !Nat.mul_0_l, !Nat.add_0_r.
1727 unfold bin. rewrite N2Nat.id, Eq. f_equal.
1728 apply N2Nat.inj. rewrite Nat2N.id, N2Nat.inj_add, Ebj. cbn. lia.
1729 + apply andb_prop in Hf. destruct Hf as [Hf H6].
1730 apply andb_prop in Hf. destruct Hf as [H4 H5].
1731 apply N.ltb_lt in H4. apply N.eqb_eq in H5, H6.
1732 rewrite (digits_val Xd Ha) at 1.
1733 rewrite digits_app_bin; [| apply val_lt; exact Ha | lia].
1734 f_equal.
1735 apply (f_equal N.to_nat) in H5, H6.
1736 rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_pow, valN_spec, Nat2N.id in H5.
1737 rewrite N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id in H6.
1738 rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, Ebj in H5. rewrite Eg in H6.
1739 change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat in H5, H6.
1740 change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat in H5.
1741 rewrite Nat.mul_add_distr_l, Nat.mul_assoc, H6. lia.
1742 - rewrite Hq. clear -Hd' Hp Hb'. nia.
1743 - rewrite Hq. clear -Hp Hb'. nia.
1744Qed.
1746Fixpoint frun (n R : nat) (F : fam) : bool :=
1747 match n with
1748 | O => false
1749 | S n' =>
1750 match fstep R F with
1751 | None => false
1752 | Some F' => canonb F' || frun n' R F'
1753 end
1754 end.
1756Lemma frun_sound n R F : frun n R F = true -> forall u, exists b', CSplus (fz F u) (Cst b').
1757Proof.
1758 revert F; induction n as [|n IH]; intros F H u; [discriminate|].
1759 cbn [frun] in H. destruct (fstep R F) as [F'|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
1760 pose proof (fstep_sound R F F' E u) as H1.
1761 destruct (canonb F') eqn:Ec.
1762 - destruct (canonb_sound F' Ec) as [b0 [g Hg]]. exists (b0 + g * u). rewrite <- Hg. constructor. exact H1.
1763 - cbn in H. destruct (IH F' H u) as [b' Hb']. exists b'. eapply CSpS; eauto.
1764Qed.

1767(* 16. Small classes: C(b) with nu2(b + 2) <= 40 (proof.md 6.6). *)
1768(* ===================================================================== *)
1770Definition Zcl (b : N) : list unt := [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] ++ binN (b + 1).
1772Definition sc_direct (k o0 : nat) : fam :=
1773 let b := (N.of_nat o0 * 2 ^ N.of_nat k - 2)%N in
1774 mkF (Zcl b) 0 0 (32 * b + 16) (32 * b + 17) 0.
1776Definition sc_fam (k o0 : nat) : fam :=
1777 let j0 := (32 * ((N.of_nat o0 + 16) * 2 ^ N.of_nat k - 2) + 17)%N in
1778 mkF ([uS1; uD0] ++ repeat uD1 (k + 4) ++ uD0 :: digits 3 ((o0 - 1) / 2)) 1 1 (j0 - 1) j0
1779 (2 ^ N.of_nat (k + 9)).
1781Definition sc_ok (k o0 : nat) : bool :=
1782 (if Nat.eqb k O && Nat.eqb o0 1%nat then true else frun 100 10000 (sc_direct k o0)) &&
1783 frun 100 (k + 9) (sc_fam k o0).
1785Fixpoint upto (n : nat) : list nat := match n with O => [] | S n' => upto n' ++ [n'] end.
1787Lemma upto_In k n : k < n -> In k (upto n).
1788Proof.
1789 induction n as [|n IH]; intros H; [lia|]. cbn [upto]. apply in_or_app.
1790 destruct (Nat.eq_dec k n) as [->|Hne]; [right; left; reflexivity|left; apply IH; lia].
1791Qed.
1793Definition odds16 : list nat := [1%nat; 3; 5; 7; 9; 11; 13; 15].
1795Lemma sc_all : forallb (fun k => forallb (fun o0 => sc_ok k o0) odds16) (upto 41) = true.
1796Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
1798Lemma sc_ok_of k o0 : k <= 40 -> In o0 odds16 -> sc_ok k o0 = true.
1799Proof.
1800 intros Hk Ho. pose proof sc_all as H.
1801 rewrite forallb_forall in H. specialize (H k (upto_In k 41 ltac:(lia))).
1802 rewrite forallb_forall in H. apply H. exact Ho.
1803Qed.
1805Lemma odd_decomp n : 0 < n -> exists k o, n = o * 2 ^ k /\ Nat.odd o = true.
1806Proof.
1807 induction n as [n IH] using lt_wf_ind. intros Hn.
1808 destruct (Nat.odd n) eqn:Eo.
1809 - exists O, n. split; [cbn; lia|exact Eo].
1810 - assert (Ee : Nat.even n = true) by (rewrite <- Nat.negb_odd, Eo; reflexivity).
1811 apply Nat.even_spec in Ee. destruct Ee as [m Hm].
1812 destruct (IH m ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia)) as [k [o [E1 E2]]].
1813 exists (S k), o. split; [rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'; lia|exact E2].
1814Qed.
1816Lemma Cst_zone k q b : b + 2 = (2 * q + 1) * 2 ^ k ->
1817 fst (fst (Cst b)) = [uS1; uD0; uD1; uD1; uD1; uD1] ++ repeat uD1 k ++ bin (2 * q).
1818Proof.
1819 intros H. cbn [Cst fst]. f_equal. rewrite <- bin_ones. f_equal.
1820 rewrite Nat.pow_add_r, Nat.pow_1_r. pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 k). nia.
1821Qed.
1823Lemma odd_mod16 o : Nat.odd o = true -> In (o mod 16) odds16.
1824Proof.
1825 intros H. assert (Ho : o mod 2 = 1%nat).
1826 { rewrite Nat.odd_spec in H. destruct H as [m Hm]. subst. rewrite Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. }
1827 assert (E : o mod 16 mod 2 = 1%nat).
1828 { transitivity (o mod 2); [|exact Ho]. rewrite (Nat.div_mod_eq o 16) at 2.
1829 replace (16 * (o / 16) + o mod 16) with (o mod 16 + (8 * (o / 16)) * 2) by lia.
1830 rewrite Nat.Div0.mod_add. reflexivity. }
1831 assert (o mod 16 < 16) by (apply Nat.mod_upper_bound; lia).
1832 remember (o mod 16) as r. clear -E H0.
1833 do 16 (destruct r as [|r]; [cbn in E; try discriminate; cbn; tauto|]). lia.
1834Qed.
1836Lemma odds16_half r : In r odds16 -> r = 2 * ((r - 1) / 2) + 1.
1837Proof. cbn. intros H. repeat (destruct H as [<-|H]; [reflexivity|]). destruct H. Qed.
1839Theorem small_classes b k o : b + 2 = o * 2 ^ k -> Nat.odd o = true -> k <= 40 ->
1840 exists b', CSplus (Cst b) (Cst b').
1841Proof.
1842 intros Hb Ho Hk.
1843 set (o0 := o mod 16).
1844 assert (Hin : In o0 odds16) by (apply odd_mod16; exact Ho).
1845 pose proof (sc_ok_of k o0 Hk Hin) as Hok. unfold sc_ok in Hok.
1846 apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hd Hf].
1847 assert (Hpk := Nat.pow_nonzero 2 k ltac:(lia)).
1848 assert (Ho16 : o = o0 + 16 * (o / 16)) by (unfold o0; pose proof (Nat.div_mod o 16); lia).
1849 assert (Hq0 : o0 = 2 * ((o0 - 1) / 2) + 1) by (apply odds16_half; exact Hin).
1850 destruct (o / 16) as [|t] eqn:Et.
1851 - (* o = o0: direct run *)
1852 rewrite Nat.mul_0_r, Nat.add_0_r in Ho16.
1853 destruct (Nat.eqb k O && Nat.eqb o0 1%nat) eqn:E0.
1854 { apply andb_prop in E0. destruct E0 as [E1 E2]. apply Nat.eqb_eq in E1, E2. subst k.
1855 rewrite E2 in Ho16. subst o. cbn in Hb. lia. }
1856 destruct (frun_sound _ _ _ Hd 0) as [b' Hb'].
1857 exists b'. replace (Cst b) with (fz (sc_direct k o0) 0); [exact Hb'|].
1858 unfold fz, sc_direct, Cst, Zcl. cbn [fX fy fay fD fj faD].
1859 assert (Eb : (N.of_nat o0 * 2 ^ N.of_nat k - 2 = N.of_nat b)%N).
1860 { apply N2Nat.inj. rewrite Nat2N.id, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_pow, !Nat2N.id.
1861 change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. rewrite <- Ho16. lia. }
1862 rewrite Eb. cbn [N.to_nat]. rewrite !Nat.mul_0_r, !Nat.add_0_r, bin_0, app_nil_r.
1863 f_equal; [f_equal|].
1864 + f_equal. unfold bin. f_equal. lia.
1865 + rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, N2Nat.inj_mul, Nat2N.id. reflexivity.
1866 + rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, N2Nat.inj_mul, Nat2N.id. reflexivity.
1867 - (* o = o0 + 16 (1 + t): the family at u = t *)
1868 destruct (frun_sound _ _ _ Hf t) as [b' Hb'].
1869 exists b'. replace (Cst b) with (fz (sc_fam k o0) t); [exact Hb'|].
1870 set (q0 := (o0 - 1) / 2) in *.
1871 set (q := q0 + 8 * (1 + t)).
1872 assert (Hoq : o = 2 * q + 1) by (unfold q; lia).
1873 assert (Hz := Cst_zone k q b ltac:(rewrite <- Hoq; exact Hb)).
1874 destruct (Cst b) as [[zc dc] jc] eqn:EC. cbn [fst] in Hz. subst zc.
1875 unfold Cst in EC. inversion EC; subst dc jc. clear EC.
1876 unfold fz, sc_fam. cbn [fX fy fay fD fj faD].
1877 f_equal; [f_equal|].
1878 + rewrite Nat.add_comm, repeat_app. cbn [repeat app]. rewrite <- !app_assoc. cbn [app].
1879 do 6 f_equal. f_equal.
1880 rewrite (bin_pos (2 * q)) by (unfold q; lia).
1881 rewrite dig_even. f_equal.
1882 replace (2 * q / 2) with q by (rewrite Nat.mul_comm, Nat.div_mul; lia).
1883 change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat.
1884 rewrite digits_app_bin.
1885 * f_equal. unfold q, q0. cbn. lia.
1886 * assert (o0 < 16) by (unfold o0; apply Nat.mod_upper_bound; lia).
1887 change (2 ^ 3) with 8%nat. apply Nat.Div0.div_lt_upper_bound. lia.
1888 * lia.
1889 + rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_add, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_mul,
1890 !N2Nat.inj_pow, N2Nat.inj_add, !Nat2N.id.
1891 change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 32) with 32%nat.
1892 change (N.to_nat 16) with 16%nat. change (N.to_nat 17) with 17%nat. change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat.
1893 rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 9) with 512%nat.
1894 assert (2 <= (o0 + 16) * 2 ^ k) by nia.
1895 rewrite Ho16 in Hb. nia.
1896 + rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, N2Nat.inj_mul, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_mul,
1897 !N2Nat.inj_pow, N2Nat.inj_add, !Nat2N.id.
1898 change (N.to_nat 2) with 2%nat. change (N.to_nat 32) with 32%nat.
1899 change (N.to_nat 16) with 16%nat. change (N.to_nat 17) with 17%nat.
1900 rewrite Nat.pow_add_r. change (2 ^ 9) with 512%nat.
1901 assert (2 <= (o0 + 16) * 2 ^ k) by nia.
1902 rewrite Ho16 in Hb. nia.
1903Qed.

1906(* 17. Value forms (proof.md 6.2): digits of V with heads at positions *)
1907(* 0..3 and the marker P at position L. *)
1908(* ===================================================================== *)
1910Fixpoint vfl (hs : list (list unt)) (L V : nat) : list unt :=
1911 match L with
1912 | O => uP :: bin V
1913 | S L' => hd [] hs ++ dig V :: vfl (tl hs) L' (V / 2)
1914 end.
1916Fixpoint vlow (hs : list (list unt)) (L R V : nat) : list unt :=
1917 match L with
1918 | O => uP :: digits R V
1919 | S L' =>
1920 match R with
1921 | O => []
1922 | S R' => hd [] hs ++ dig V :: vlow (tl hs) L' R' (V / 2)
1923 end
1924 end.
1926Lemma digits_mod R V s : digits R (V + 2 ^ R * s) = digits R V.
1927Proof.
1928 revert V; induction R as [|R IH]; intros V; [reflexivity|].
1929 cbn [digits]. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'.
1930 replace (V + 2 * 2 ^ R * s) with (V + 2 * (2 ^ R * s)) by lia.
1931 rewrite dig_add_even, div2_add_even, IH. reflexivity.
1932Qed.
1934Lemma digits_bin_split R V : 2 ^ R <= V -> bin V = digits R V ++ bin (V / 2 ^ R).
1935Proof.
1936 intros H. pose proof (Nat.pow_nonzero 2 R ltac:(lia)) as Hp.
1937 pose proof (Nat.div_mod_eq V (2 ^ R)) as Ed.
1938 assert (E : digits R V = digits R (V mod 2 ^ R)).
1939 { rewrite <- (digits_mod R (V mod 2 ^ R) (V / 2 ^ R)). f_equal. lia. }
1940 rewrite E, digits_app_bin.
1941 - f_equal. lia.
1942 - apply Nat.mod_upper_bound. lia.
1943 - apply Nat.div_str_pos. lia.
1944Qed.
1946Lemma vfl_split hs L R V : L < R -> 2 ^ R <= V -> vfl hs L V = vlow hs L R V ++ bin (V / 2 ^ R).
1947Proof.
1948 revert hs R V; induction L as [|L IH]; intros hs R V HL HV.
1949 - cbn [vfl vlow app]. f_equal. apply digits_bin_split. exact HV.
1950 - destruct R as [|R]; [lia|]. cbn [vfl vlow]. rewrite <- app_assoc. cbn [app]. f_equal. f_equal.
1951 rewrite (IH (tl hs) R (V / 2)) by (try lia; rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r' in HV; apply Nat.div_le_lower_bound; lia).
1952 f_equal. f_equal. rewrite Nat.Div0.div_div. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'. reflexivity.
1953Qed.
1955Lemma vlow_mod hs L R V s : vlow hs L R (V + 2 ^ R * s) = vlow hs L R V.
1956Proof.
1957 revert hs R V; induction L as [|L IH]; intros hs R V.
1958 - cbn [vlow]. rewrite digits_mod. reflexivity.
1959 - destruct R as [|R]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [vlow]. rewrite Nat.pow_succ_r'.
1960 replace (V + 2 * 2 ^ R * s) with (V + 2 * (2 ^ R * s)) by lia.
1961 rewrite dig_add_even, div2_add_even, IH. reflexivity.
1962Qed.
1964(* rows: heads at positions 0..3, lambda, mu, the w slope alpha, w = alpha off + wp - wn, D = j - d *)
1965Record vrow := mkV { vh : list (list unt); vlam : nat; vmu : nat; val_ : nat; vwp : nat; vwn : nat; vd : nat }.
1967Definition phrows : list vrow :=
1968 [ mkV [[uS1]] 24 1 1 0 20 2;
1969 mkV [[uS1]] 24 1 1 0 20 2;
1970 mkV [[]; [uS1]] 24 1 1 0 20 2;
1971 mkV [[]; [uSP]] 25 2 2 0 42 3;
1972 mkV [[uS1; uP; uP]] 24 1 1 0 24 4;
1973 mkV [[]; []; [uS1]] 24 1 1 0 21 2;
1974 mkV [[]; [uS1; uP]] 24 1 1 0 24 3;
1975 mkV [[uS1; uP; uP]] 24 1 1 0 24 4 ].
1977Definition phrow (phi : nat) : vrow := nth phi phrows (mkV [] 24 1 1 0 24 4).
1979Definition vfz (r : vrow) (k Om off : nat) : st :=
1980 let L := k + vlam r - off in
1981 let V := vmu r * Om + val_ r * off + vwp r - (vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (L - 1)) in
1982 let j := Om + off - 64 in
1983 (vfl (vh r) L V, j - vd r, j).
1985Definition off_end (k : nat) : nat := if Nat.eqb ((k + 20) mod 8) 3 then k + 21 else k + 20.
1987Definition VFe (k Om : nat) : st := vfz (phrow (off_end k mod 8)) k Om (off_end k).
1989(* the same in N, for the family bases *)
1990Fixpoint digitsN (r : nat) (v : N) : list unt :=
1991 match r with O => [] | S r' => digN v :: digitsN r' (N.div2 v) end.
1993Lemma digitsN_spec r v : digitsN r v = digits r (N.to_nat v).
1994Proof.
1995 revert v; induction r as [|r IH]; intros v; [reflexivity|]. cbn [digitsN digits].
1996 rewrite IH, digN_dig, N2Nat.inj_div2, Nat.div2_div. reflexivity.
1997Qed.
1999Fixpoint vlowN (hs : list (list unt)) (L R : nat) (V : N) : list unt :=
2000 match L with
2001 | O => uP :: digitsN R V
2002 | S L' =>
2003 match R with
2004 | O => []
2005 | S R' => hd [] hs ++ digN V :: vlowN (tl hs) L' R' (N.div2 V)
2006 end
2007 end.
2009Lemma vlowN_spec hs L R V : vlowN hs L R V = vlow hs L R (N.to_nat V).
2010Proof.
2011 revert hs R V; induction L as [|L IH]; intros hs R V; cbn [vlowN vlow].
2012 - rewrite digitsN_spec. reflexivity.
2013 - destruct R; [reflexivity|]. rewrite IH, digN_dig, N2Nat.inj_div2, Nat.div2_div. reflexivity.
2014Qed.
2016(* the family of VF states at the end offset: base (k0, Om0), cut R; all in N *)
2017Definition off_endN (k : N) : N := if N.eqb ((k + 20) mod 8) 3 then (k + 21)%N else (k + 20)%N.
2019Definition egr (k0 : N) : vrow := phrow (N.to_nat (off_endN k0 mod 8)).
2021Definition egL (k0 : N) : nat := N.to_nat (k0 + N.of_nat (vlam (egr k0)) - off_endN k0).
2023Definition egV (k0 : N) (Om0 : N) : N :=
2024 (N.of_nat (vmu (egr k0)) * Om0 + N.of_nat (val_ (egr k0)) * off_endN k0 + N.of_nat (vwp (egr k0)) -
2025 N.of_nat (vwn (egr k0) + 3 * 2 ^ (egL k0 - 1)))%N.
2027Definition egF (k0 : N) (Om0 : N) (R : nat) : fam :=
2028 let j0 := (Om0 + off_endN k0 - 64)%N in
2029 mkF (vlowN (vh (egr k0)) (egL k0) R (egV k0 Om0)) (egV k0 Om0 / 2 ^ N.of_nat R) 1
2030 (j0 - N.of_nat (vd (egr k0))) j0 (2 ^ N.of_nat R).
2032Definition egok (k0 : N) (Om0 : N) (R : nat) : bool :=
2033 Nat.ltb (egL k0) R && N.leb (2 ^ N.of_nat R) (egV k0 Om0) && N.leb 64 Om0 &&
2034 Nat.eqb (vmu (egr k0)) 1 && Nat.eqb (val_ (egr k0)) 1 && Nat.leb (vd (egr k0)) 20 &&
2035 frun 120 R (egF k0 Om0 R).
2037Definition egbase (kap : nat) : N := N.of_nat (if Nat.ltb kap 41 then kap + 4096 else kap).
2039Definition eg_ok (kap : nat) : bool :=
2040 Nat.eqb ((kap + 9) mod 2048) O || egok (egbase kap) (2 ^ 46) 12.
2042Lemma eg_all : forallb eg_ok (upto 4096) = true.
2043Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
2045Definition ns_ok (v : nat) (s0 : N) : bool :=
2046 egok (s0 * 2 ^ N.of_nat v - 9) (2 ^ N.of_nat (v + 10)) (v + 2).
2048Lemma ns_all : forallb (fun v => ns_ok (v + 11) 1 && ns_ok (v + 11) 3) (upto 40) = true.
2049Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
2051Lemma off_endN_spec k : N.to_nat (off_endN k) = off_end (N.to_nat k).
2052Proof.
2053 unfold off_endN, off_end.
2054 replace (N.eqb ((k + 20) mod 8) 3) with (Nat.eqb ((N.to_nat k + 20) mod 8) 3).
2055 - destruct (Nat.eqb _ _); lia.
2056 - rewrite <- (N2Nat.id ((k + 20) mod 8)). rewrite N2Nat.inj_mod, N2Nat.inj_add.
2057 change (N.to_nat 20) with 20%nat. change (N.to_nat 8) with 8%nat.
2058 destruct (Nat.eqb_spec ((N.to_nat k + 20) mod 8) 3) as [E|E]; symmetry.
2059 + apply N.eqb_eq. rewrite E. reflexivity.
2060 + apply N.eqb_neq. intros C. apply E. apply (f_equal N.to_nat) in C. rewrite Nat2N.id in C. exact C.
2061Qed.
2063Lemma mod8_of k k0 R : 3 <= R -> k0 <= k -> (k - k0) mod 2 ^ R = O -> k mod 8 = k0 mod 8.
2064Proof.
2065 intros HR Hk H. apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in H. destruct H as [c Hc].
2066 replace k with (k0 + (2 ^ (R - 3) * c) * 8).
2067 - apply Nat.Div0.mod_add.
2068 - replace R with (3 + (R - 3)) in Hc by lia. rewrite Nat.pow_add_r in Hc. cbn in Hc. lia.
2069Qed.
2071Lemma off_end_shift k k0 : k mod 8 = k0 mod 8 -> off_end k = k + (off_end k0 - k0) /\ k0 + 20 <= off_end k0 /\
2072 off_end k mod 8 = off_end k0 mod 8.
2073Proof.
2074 intros H. unfold off_end.
2075 assert (E : (k + 20) mod 8 = (k0 + 20) mod 8).
2076 { rewrite (Nat.Div0.add_mod k), (Nat.Div0.add_mod k0), H. reflexivity. }
2077 rewrite E. destruct (Nat.eqb ((k0 + 20) mod 8) 3); (split; [lia|split; [lia|]]).
2078 - replace (k + 21) with (k + 21) by reflexivity. rewrite (Nat.Div0.add_mod k), (Nat.Div0.add_mod k0), H. reflexivity.
2079 - rewrite (Nat.Div0.add_mod k), (Nat.Div0.add_mod k0), H. reflexivity.
2080Qed.
2082Lemma eg_family k0 Om0 R k Om : egok k0 Om0 R = true -> 3 <= R -> N.to_nat k0 <= k ->
2083 (k - N.to_nat k0) mod 2 ^ R = O -> N.to_nat Om0 <= Om -> (Om - N.to_nat Om0) mod 2 ^ R = O ->
2084 exists b', CSplus (VFe k Om) (Cst b').
2085Proof.
2086 intros Hok HR Hk HkR HO HOR.
2087 unfold egok in Hok.
2088 apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hrun].
2089 apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hd].
2090 apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hal].
2091 apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok Hmu].
2092 apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [Hok H64].
2093 apply andb_prop in Hok. destruct Hok as [HL HV].
2094 apply Nat.ltb_lt in HL. apply N.leb_le in HV, H64. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hmu, Hal. apply Nat.leb_le in Hd.
2095 assert (Hpr := Nat.pow_nonzero 2 R ltac:(lia)).
2096 apply Nat.Div0.mod_divides in HkR, HOR. destruct HkR as [ck Hck], HOR as [cO HcO].
2097 set (u := cO + ck).
2098 destruct (frun_sound _ _ _ Hrun u) as [b' Hb']. exists b'.
2099 replace (VFe k Om) with (fz (egF k0 Om0 R) u); [exact Hb'|].
2100 set (n0 := N.to_nat k0) in *.
2101 assert (H8 : k mod 8 = n0 mod 8).
2102 { apply (mod8_of k n0 R); auto. rewrite Hck, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.Div0.mod_mul. reflexivity. }
2103 destruct (off_end_shift k n0 H8) as [Eoff [Hoff Eom]].
2104 set (off0 := off_end n0) in *.
2105 assert (Eo0 : N.to_nat (off_endN k0) = off0) by (unfold off0, n0; apply off_endN_spec).
2106 assert (Er : egr k0 = phrow (off_end k mod 8)).
2107 { unfold egr. rewrite Eom. f_equal. rewrite N2Nat.inj_mod, Eo0. reflexivity. }
2108 set (r := egr k0) in *.
2109 assert (EL : egL k0 = k + vlam r - off_end k).
2110 { unfold egL. fold r. rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_add, Nat2N.id, Eo0. fold n0. lia. }
2111 set (L := egL k0) in *.
2112 set (Om0' := N.to_nat Om0) in *.
2113 assert (EV0 : N.to_nat (egV k0 Om0) = Om0' + off0 + vwp r - (vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (L - 1))).
2114 { unfold egV. fold r L. rewrite N2Nat.inj_sub, !N2Nat.inj_add, !N2Nat.inj_mul, !Nat2N.id, Eo0, Hmu, Hal.
2115 fold Om0'. lia. }
2116 set (V0 := N.to_nat (egV k0 Om0)) in *.
2117 assert (HV' : 2 ^ R <= V0).
2118 { unfold V0. replace (2 ^ R) with (N.to_nat (2 ^ N.of_nat R)) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id; reflexivity). lia. }
2119 assert (EV : vmu r * Om + val_ r * off_end k + vwp r - (vwn r + 3 * 2 ^ (k + vlam r - off_end k - 1))
2120 = V0 + 2 ^ R * u).
2121 { rewrite <- EL. fold L. rewrite Hmu, Hal. unfold u. rewrite Eoff. lia. }

2123 unfold fz, egF. cbn [fX fy fay fD fj faD]. fold r L. rewrite vlowN_spec. fold V0.
2124 assert (Ep : N.to_nat (2 ^ N.of_nat R) = 2 ^ R) by (rewrite N2Nat.inj_pow, Nat2N.id; reflexivity).
2125 f_equal; [f_equal|].
2126 - rewrite (vfl_split (vh r) L R (V0 + 2 ^ R * u)) by lia.
2127 rewrite vlow_mod, div_mod_shift. f_equal. f_equal.
2128 rewrite N2Nat.inj_div, Ep. change (N.to_nat 1) with 1%nat. fold V0. lia.
2129 - rewrite Ep, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_add, Eo0, Nat2N.id.

2131 assert (64 <= Om0') by (unfold Om0'; lia). lia.
2132 - rewrite Ep, N2Nat.inj_sub, N2Nat.inj_add, Eo0.
2133 change (N.to_nat 64) with 64%nat. fold Om0'. unfold u. rewrite Eoff.
2134 assert (64 <= Om0') by (unfold Om0'; lia). lia.
